Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

 About the Role

We are hiring a mid-level Systems Engineer to take hands-on ownership of Infiterra ’s internal IT environment. The role combines Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, endpoint and systems management, employee IT support, access and security controls, and automation.

Your mission is to provide secure, reliable and increasingly automated corporate IT services to Infiterra employees. You will own day-to-day corporate IT operations while improving automation, identity and access management, endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes and service quality.

Moreover, you will have the opportunity to help evolve the function from largely operational support into a standardized, secure and increasingly automated internal IT service. This is not an L1 support position — support is part of the job, but the purpose of the role is to engineer and operate Internal IT as a scalable service.

 Key Responsibilities

Identity & Access Management

-
Keep corporate identities in Entra ID / Azure AD accurate, well-organized and easy to audit.

-
Structure users, groups and roles so they map cleanly to how the business actually works.

-
Deliver secure, low-friction MFA and SSO, backed by Conditional Access policies that keep unauthorized access out.

-
Grant access the moment someone needs it, and revoke it the moment they no longer do.

-
Keep privileged accounts tightly controlled, with no lingering or unused elevated access.

-
Catch and correct access drift through regular reviews, before it becomes a risk.

-
Act as Security's reliable partner in shaping and validating access policy decisions.

Employee Lifecycle

-
Own the technical onboarding, role/access changes and offboarding process and run without gaps.

-
Get every new employee productive from day one, with accounts, devices and applications ready before they start, and cut off access immediately once employment ends.

Endpoint & Device Management

-
Keep every company laptop on the security baseline and current on patches, without employees ever noticing the effort behind it.

-
Keep the device fleet fully accounted for, replace ageing hardware before it becomes a problem, and stay audit-ready on compliance reporting.

Corporate Systems & SaaS Administration

-
Keep the internal Microsoft / Azure environment and core SaaS applications running reliably, with no unplanned downtime or configuration drift.

-
Keep licensing spend, permissions and integrations accurate and well documented, so there's never confusion about who owns what.

Internal Support & Service Management

-
Give employees fast, dependable help when something breaks, and make sure they always know exactly where to turn.

-
Meet SLAs consistently, so waiting on IT is never the reason work stalls.

-
Grow a knowledge base that resolves issues faster over time, instead of solving them from memory each time.

-
Fix recurring issues at the root, so ticket volume trends down instead of repeating.

Security & Compliance Operations

-
Keep access evidence, endpoint compliance, asset inventories and account lifecycle records ready to hand over for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit.

-
Run IT controls reliably day to day, giving Security confidence in the operational layer without having to manage it themselves.

 Ideal Candidate Profile

-
A Systems Engineer with hands-on Internal IT operations experience, comfortable across Microsoft 365, Azure and endpoint management.

-
A structured problem solver who gets to the root cause instead of repeating the workaround.

-
A clear communicator who can support colleagues of all technical levels.

-
An ownership mindset: you take a process end to end and improve it as you go.

-

jobs.summary: With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such...
jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business unit covering Costa Rica and Mexico.

Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the Sales Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Costa Rica and parts of Mexico, primarily the surrounding areas of Mexico City. The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and growing an existing portfolio of customers. This is a remote role based in in Costa Rica.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager will work closely with customers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen customer relationships, and drive order intake and market growth.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica and France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*

Become a part of our caring community The Senior Systems Engineer, Patch Management is responsible for the strategy, administration, automation, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch and vulnerability management processes across Windows, Linux, virtual, cloud, and end-user computing platforms.

 Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Systems Engineer, Patch Management is responsible for the strategy, administration, automation, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch and vulnerability management processes across Windows, Linux, virtual, cloud, and end-user computing platforms. This role ensures systems remain secure, compliant, and operationally stable while partnering with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to reduce risk and maintain service reliability.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with operational leadership, driving patch compliance, vulnerability remediation, automation, reporting, and process improvements across a large-scale enterprise environment.
Key Responsibilities

Patch Management & Vulnerability Remediation

- Lead enterprise patch management operations across Windows Server, Linux, virtual infrastructure, cloud platforms, and endpoint devices.

- Develop and maintain patch deployment strategies, schedules, maintenance windows, and compliance standards.

- Coordinate remediation efforts for critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities identified through vulnerability management platforms.

- Manage exception and risk acceptance processes in partnership with Information Security and application owners.

Platform Administration

- Administer enterprise patching technologies including Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Intune, Red Hat Satellite, Ansible.

- Support operating system lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-support remediation activities.

- Ensure successful deployment and validation of security updates across production and non-production environments.

Automation & Process Improvement

- Design and implement automation solutions to improve patching efficiency, reporting, and compliance tracking.

- Continuously improve deployment processes, monitoring capabilities, and operational standards.

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and increase deployment reliability.

Compliance & Reporting

- Maintain patch compliance metrics and service-level objectives.

- Create executive and operational reporting for vulnerability remediation, compliance status, aging vulnerabilities, and risk exposure.

- Ensure adherence to regulatory, security, and organizational compliance requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, Application Support, and Engineering teams to coordinate patching activities.

- Provide technical leadership during major vulnerability response events and emergency patching situations.

- Participate in change management reviews, maintenance planning, and production readiness assessments.

- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical skill development within the team.

 Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise patch management, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or vulnerability remediation.

- Strong experience with Windows Server and Linux administration in large-scale enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience with enterprise patching tools such as MECM/SCCM, Intune, Red Hat Satellite, Ansible, or equivalent platforms.

- Experience managing vulnerability remediation activities using tools such as Qualys, Rapid7, or similar vulnerability management solutions.

- Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading enterprise patch compliance or vulnerability management programs.

- Experience supporting cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

- Knowledge of security frameworks and standards including NIST, CIS Benchmarks, and vulnerability management best practices.

- Experience creating executive dashboards, compliance reporting, and operational metrics.

- Relevant certifications such as Security+, CISSP, RHCSA/RHCE, Azure Administrator, Microsoft Certified, or similar industry certifications.

Additional Information

Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Our client is seeking two Senior Endpoint Platform Engineers who will design, implement, and operate secure, scalable enterprise endpoint management platforms. This role combines deep endpoint engineering expertise with operational judgment, governance awareness, automation, observability, and data-driven decision-making. The engineer will independently lead initiatives, navigate ambiguity, balance security requirements with operational realities, and build sustainable platform capabilities that can be adopted across teams and business units.

Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and operate enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM).

• Develop and maintain Windows endpoint standards, including Windows Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and Windows Update for Business.

• Engineer scalable processes for Win32 application packaging and deployment, as well as driver, BIOS, and firmware management.

• Design identity and administration models using Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Access Packages, role-based access control (RBAC), delegated administration, Scope Tags, and least-privilege principles.

• Build reusable automation and configuration-as-code solutions using PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, GitHub Actions, JSON, and YAML.

• Apply Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and documentation-as-code practices to endpoint platform engineering and operations.

• Define telemetry strategies and instrumentation that support service observability, operational health measurement, and data-driven decision making.

• Develop dashboards, reports, monitoring, and alerts using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Splunk Enterprise, and Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL).

• Lead complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis for endpoint platform, application deployment, compliance, identity, and operational issues.

• Implement and maintain vulnerability management, security baselines, hardening standards, Zero Trust principles, change controls, and auditable operating practices.

• Assess tradeoffs, blast radius, resiliency, and risk when designing or changing endpoint services.

• Document architecture decisions, technical rationale, support procedures, and long-term ownership models.

• Partner across engineering, governance, security, operations, and leadership teams to align platform outcomes with business objectives.

• Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences.

• Enable other teams through standards, automation, reusable capabilities, and knowledge transfer rather than creating operational dependencies.

• Demonstrate ownership from solution design through implementation and operational support.

Required Qualifications

• Senior-level experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise endpoint management platforms at scale.

• Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows endpoint management, Windows Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, compliance and configuration management, Win32 application deployment, Windows Update for Business, and hardware lifecycle management.

• Experience designing enterprise identity governance and delegated administration models using Microsoft Entra ID, PIM, Access Packages, RBAC, Scope Tags, and least-privilege practices.

• Advanced automation and scripting experience with PowerShell and working experience with Python, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, GitHub Actions, JSON, and YAML.

• Experience applying Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, automated testing, and documentation-as-code concepts.

• Experience designing telemetry, dashboards, reporting, monitoring, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, KQL, Splunk Enterprise, or SPL.

• Strong knowledge of vulnerability management, security baselines, endpoint hardening, Zero Trust, change control, auditability, and risk-based prioritization.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions with evidence, and balance business, operational, and security requirements.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

• Proven ability to build maintainable, supportable, and scalable platforms rather than one-time solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading large-scale endpoint migrations or MECM-to-Intune transformations.

• Experience supporting shared-service or multi-business-unit environments.

• Experience developing governance models, operating models, and enterprise platform standards.

• Experience establishing service observability and operational reporting for endpoint platforms.

• Experience engaging cross-functional stakeholders and influencing technical and executive audiences.

jobs.description:
Position OverviewMetroSys is seeking an experienced Senior SCCM Patch Management Consultant to support a regional credit union in assessing, improving, and modernizing its enterprise patch-management environment.

Position Overview

 MetroSys is seeking an experienced Senior SCCM Patch Management Consultant to support a regional credit union in assessing, improving, and modernizing its enterprise patch-management environment.

The consultant will serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager , reviewing the client's current SCCM architecture, patching processes, deployment methodology, reporting, automation, and overall patch compliance.

This role will begin with a comprehensive assessment of the existing environment and progress into recommendations and hands-on improvements. The consultant will identify SCCM configuration gaps, improve patching processes, increase automation, and help establish a more reliable and repeatable enterprise patch-management program.

The environment is primarily Microsoft-based with some Linux infrastructure and supports banking, security, and regulated workloads. The consultant should understand the operational and compliance requirements associated with patching systems within a financial-services environment.

The initial engagement is expected to last approximately three months , with the possibility of extension and/or permanent employment based on project needs.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform a comprehensive assessment of the existing SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager environment and enterprise patch-management process.

- Review SCCM architecture, site configuration, distribution points, Software Update Points, WSUS integration, client health, boundaries, collections, and overall platform health.

- Evaluate existing SCCM Software Update Groups, Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs), device collections, maintenance windows, deployment schedules, and reboot policies .

- Review current Windows Server and endpoint patching processes to identify coverage gaps, failed deployments, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement.

- Assess SCCM patch-compliance reporting and develop recommendations for improving visibility into compliant, non-compliant, failed, offline, and pending-reboot systems.

- Design or improve SCCM patching rings and deployment collections for test, pilot, production, critical infrastructure, and exception groups.

- Develop and implement SCCM automation to reduce manual patch-management activities and improve consistency.

- Utilize PowerShell and other automation technologies to improve SCCM administration, reporting, remediation, and patching workflows.

- Review existing patch testing, approval, deployment, rollback, maintenance-window, and emergency patching procedures.

- Identify opportunities to automate patch identification, deployment, validation, remediation, and compliance reporting.

- Evaluate where AI-assisted technologies could provide practical value within patch management, reporting, troubleshooting, vulnerability prioritization, or operational workflows.

- Work with security and vulnerability-management teams to align SCCM patch deployments with identified vulnerabilities and organizational risk.

- Support patching requirements across a primarily Microsoft environment , while helping establish appropriate processes for Linux and other infrastructure not directly managed through SCCM.

- Review patch-management practices against applicable banking, security, PCI, and internal compliance requirements .

- Troubleshoot SCCM client, deployment, distribution, update, and reporting issues.

- Create or improve patch-management dashboards, reports, KPIs, and audit documentation.

- Develop a prioritized SCCM and patch-management improvement roadmap.

- Implement approved SCCM configuration, automation, reporting, and process improvements during the engagement.

- Document configurations, procedures, recommendations, and operational standards and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams.

 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the data they access .

The Endpoint Security team extends these controls directly to user devices, detecting AI tools and agents running on laptops and workstations, monitoring their access to local data, and enforcing security policies where traffic never reaches a gateway.

-
 5+ years of backend or systems development experience, including 3+ years building production software in Go .

- Working knowledge of Python for tooling and testing.

- Experience with gRPC/REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes , and at least one major cloud provider.

- Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

- Previous experience in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust & safety.

During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real-world software development, including the tools you use, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.

We're looking for engineers who use AI as a force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem-solving , not simply as an autocomplete tool.

- Solve challenging systems problems across operating systems, networking, security, and distributed backend infrastructure.

jobs.description:
IT EngineerAbout the companyHi, we're Ondo Finance.

IT Engineer

About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance . Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we're backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated, systems-oriented IT Engineer to join our Corporate IT team. This role combines hands-on IT operations and Tier 1–2 support with ownership of identity, access, endpoint management, and employee lifecycle workflows.

You will work closely with the IT Operations Engineer and Security team to operate and continuously improve a modern, SaaS-first, highly automated IT environment. This is a junior but high-impact role designed for someone who wants to grow into identity-driven, automation-focused IT.

Responsibilities

Identity, Access & SaaS Operations

- Support day-to-day administration of IAM platforms such as Okta (or similar IdPs), including user lifecycle workflows, access provisioning, group management, and MFA.

- Assist with SSO and SCIM integrations between IAM systems and SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and other internal tools.

- Help enforce least-privilege access principles and support periodic access reviews and audits.

- Execute secure and timely access provisioning and deprovisioning aligned with documented lifecycle processes.

Endpoint & Device Management

- Support macOS endpoint management using Addigy, Iru, or similar platforms.

- Assist with device enrollment, compliance monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle workflows.

- Coordinate device preparation, shipping, replacements, and secure device recovery for offboarding employees.

- Help maintain endpoint security standards and configuration baselines.

Employee Lifecycle & Automation

- Execute and coordinate end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, including:

  - Account provisioning and access configuration

  - Device setup and logistics

  - Role-based access enforcement

  - Secure deactivation and asset recovery

- Assist in building and maintaining low-code / no-code automations (e.g., Okta Workflows) to reduce manual effort and increase reliability.

- Ensure lifecycle processes are documented, repeatable, and auditable.

- Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle efficiency and reduce operational risk.

Tier 1 & 2 IT Support

- Provide day-to-day IT support across identity, SaaS applications, access issues, and macOS endpoints.

- Serve as an escalation point for more complex access, integration, or device issues.

- Perform structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis rather than applying temporary fixes.

- Identify recurring operational problems and contribute to durable, system-level improvements.

Vendor Lifecycle & IT Operations

- Support vendor onboarding, evaluation, and renewals.

- Assist with SaaS access reviews and vendor offboarding.

- Help maintain visibility into vendor usage, contracts, and lifecycle status.

- Contribute to improving procurement and asset tracking processes.

Requirements

- 2–3 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, or systems-focused roles.

- Experience providing Tier 1–2 IT support in a SaaS-heavy environment.

- Solid understanding of identity and access management fundamentals, including SSO, SCIM, MFA, and RBAC.

- Hands-on experience with IAM platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, or similar.

- Experience supporting Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 environments.

- Experience supporting macOS environments or strong endpoint fundamentals.

- Comfort working in a terminal / CLI environment appropriate to experience level.

- Ability to read and modify scripts written in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

- Strong written communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Backgrounds in Microsoft-centric environments (O365, Azure AD, Intune) are welcome, provided there is comfort learning Okta and SaaS-first tooling.

Nice to haves

- Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Addigy, JAMF, Iru, or Intune.

- Experience building or maintaining low-code / no-code automations (e.g., Okta Workflows).

- Exposure to SaaS-first, identity-driven IT architectures.

- Familiarity with vendor management, procurement workflows, or asset lifecycle tracking.

- Interest in identity governance, security-adjacent work, or enterprise automation.

- Relevant certifications (Okta certifications, CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Google Workspace, Microsoft certifications).

What we offer

- Competitive compensation including salary and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation

- Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)

- Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices

- A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom

- Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

Job Title: Microsoft Endpoint Services Manager

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an accomplished and forward‑leaning Microsoft Endpoint Services Manager to manage one of our Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) engineering teams supporting the EITaaS program. This role is built for an engineering leader who thrives on driving continuous improvement, elevating technical execution, and enabling teams to deliver resilient, scalable enterprise solutions.

As the Microsoft Endpoint Services Manager, you will guide and mentor a team of engineers responsible for architecting, implementing, and enhancing an enterprise‑grade Unified Endpoint Management solution for Microsoft Windows endpoints across the Department of the Air Force (DAF). Your leadership will ensure engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and alignment with CACI’s technical standards and the strategic objectives of the EITaaS program.

Within the EITaaS environment, CACI provides modernized capabilities and services—including enterprise ITSM, service desk operations, endpoint management and security, CONUS/OCONUS field support, and full life‑cycle sustainment for end‑user devices. Your team’s engineering outcomes will directly support the DAF’s transformation from IT‑centric operations to mission‑focused operations, driving increased agility, reliability, and security across the enterprise

This position is hybrid, with on-site work located in Chantilly, VA.

Responsibilities:

  * Lead the design and defining of system architecture for Windows desktop solutions and applications
  * Review completion and implementation of system additions and enhancements with recommendations to senior leaders related to continual improvement
  * Lead the planning and execution of UEM engineering projects, focusing on enhancing and optimizing our tool implementations.
  * Manage a team of experienced engineers and administrators focused on enterprise endpoint management tool and platforms for software deployment, patching, and compliance reporting
  * Maintain and document workflows, designs, and data flows of endpoint platforms, management tools with a focus on security and compliance
  * Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams on project execution and incident resolution
  * Establish endpoint configuration standards across a large and complex enterprise environment
  * Plan, execute, and close engineering projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.
  * Develop and implement strategies for improving UEM processes, systems, and products, with a focus on short-term results (1 year or less).
  * Identify, communicate and provide mitigation recommendations on risks and issues
  * Maintain industry knowledge with a focus on maintaining a secure and compliant environment and provide Continual Improvement recommendations
  * Develop Dashboards, Reports, and Metrics that provide leadership with ability to make decisions and view health of enterprise systems
  * Communicate effectively and collaboratively with customers, stakeholders, and peers
  * Support daily updates of project status, roadblocks, and areas of support needs
  * Amplify a team of engineers focused on endpoint management technologies by identifying individual areas of opportunity for growth and accountability

Qualifications:

Required:

  * 12+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field may be substituted for 5 years of relevant experience).
  * Minimum 8 years of experience in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) systems engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  * Demonstrated understanding of operations within a complex hybrid environment.
  * Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing teams of 6+ experienced professionals.
  * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and explain policies/procedures to stakeholders within and outside the job function.
  * Advanced knowledge in UEM systems engineering and related technical disciplines.
  * An active DoD secret clearance
  * Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  * Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced and highly complex environment with frequently changing requirements

Desired:

  * Experience with ServiceNow
  * Additional certifications such as PMP, ITIL, CISSP, or Microsoft certifications.
  * Experience with implementing and optimizing cloud-based UEM solutions.
  * Experience with DOD, DOW, or Federal Agencies

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$113,200 - $237,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

This role is four days on-site at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

Overview
M&T Bank is seeking a skilled Desktop Engineer to join our Endpoint Engineering team, with a primary focus on Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Windows endpoint management, and enterprise device deployment. This role will play a key part in supporting and expanding the Bank's ATM imaging and endpoint management initiatives while partnering closely with the ATM Engineering team.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong desktop engineering background, advanced troubleshooting skills, and hands-on experience managing Windows operating systems at enterprise scale. Experience supporting ATM platforms is beneficial but not required. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn the ATM environment while leveraging their endpoint engineering expertise to drive operational efficiency, stability, and innovation.

Primary Responsibilities
SCCM / Endpoint Management
Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including operating system deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance reporting, and application lifecycle management.Design, build, and maintain Windows device images and deployment methodologies for enterprise endpoints and ATM platforms.Develop and maintain endpoint standards, configurations, and deployment processes to ensure secure, reliable, and consistent device experiences.
ATM Imaging & Platform Support
Partner with the ATM Engineering team to build, maintain, and support ATM imaging solutions.Assist with operating system upgrades, software deployments, hardware refresh initiatives, and endpoint management activities within the ATM environment.Participate in testing, validation, and rollout activities for ATM hardware and software changes.
Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution
Serve as a senior technical resource for complex endpoint issues involving operating systems, applications, deployment systems, drivers, networking, and hardware.Perform root cause analysis and drive resolution of recurring technical problems.Collaborate with support teams and vendors to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve enterprise endpoint and ATM-related issues.
Automation & Process Improvement
Utilize PowerShell and other automation tools to improve operational efficiency, deployment processes, and reporting capabilities.Identify opportunities to streamline engineering and support processes through automation and tooling enhancements.
Collaboration & Documentation
Work closely with Desktop Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure, ATM Engineering, and Service Desk teams.Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.Participate in project planning, implementation, testing, and support activities across endpoint technology initiatives.
Education and Experience Required:
Combined minimum of 6 years' higher education and/or work experience in systems design, management and/or architectureStrong hands-on experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including:
Operating System Deployment (OSD)Software Packaging and DeploymentPatch ManagementTask SequencesDevice Compliance and Reporting
Deep knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems and endpoint lifecycle management.Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across operating systems, applications, hardware, drivers, networking, and deployment technologies.Experience creating and supporting enterprise device images.Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multiple technology teams.Experience managing incidents, problem investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.
Education and Experience Preferred:
5+ years of experience in Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or Systems Engineering in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.Experience supporting ATM platforms, kiosk devices, retail technology, or other specialized endpoint systems.Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern device management technologies.Familiarity with endpoint security controls and enterprise device compliance requirements.Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar IT service management platforms.Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint security practices.Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to play a significant role in modernizing and supporting M&T Bank's endpoint and ATM deployment environment. You'll work on highly visible initiatives, solve complex technical challenges, and help deliver secure and reliable technology solutions across the enterprise.

Key Focus Areas (in priority order)
SCCM / MECM Administration & Engineering
Windows Imaging & Operating System Deployment
Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
ATM Imaging and Platform Support
PowerShell Automation & Process Improvement

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100.00 - $161,800.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate's particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Buffalo, New York, United States of America

jobs.description:
Company Description WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That's where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn't theoretical work. It's real systems, at real scale, people solving someof the hardest challenges in technology today.

We're looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let's shape the future of data.

  Position Overview

WD is seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic partner and operational advisor jointly supporting the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience. This role sits at the intersection of two complementary IT organizations, connecting strategy to execution across both portfolios and ensuring the combinedleadership team operates with shared clarity, alignment, and accountability.

The Chief of Staff works alongside both VP leaders to drive organizational priorities forward, maintain operational rhythm, and represent IT interests across cross-functional forums. Given the dual scope of this role, the ability to hold context across multiple domains, balance competing priorities thoughtfully, and build trust with two distinct leadership teams is essential. This is a high-visibility, high-trust role that requires sound judgment, executive presence, strong communication instincts, and the ability to operate effectively across a complex, matrixed global technology organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Enablement & Organizational Leadership

Partner with both the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience to develop, refine, and communicate IT strategic priorities across their respective organizations and to shared stakeholders

Translate strategy across both IT portfolios into actionable roadmaps, plans, and organizational commitments

Serve as a thought partner to both VP leaders on organizational decisions, planning trade-offs, and priority setting

Help identify opportunities for alignment, synergy, and shared execution across the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience organizations

Represent both VP leadership interests in cross-functional forums, planning sessions, and executive reviews as appropriate

Help shape and steward the IT organizational narrative across both domains, ensuring consistent messaging for internal and external audiences

Operational Execution & Cadence

Own the operating cadence across both IT organizations, including leadership team rhythms, QBRs, strategic planning cycles, and technology reviews

Drive accountability across both leadership teams for key commitments, deliverables, and milestones

Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, escalating or connecting stakeholders where needed

Maintain visibility into initiative portfolios across both organizations, surfacing risks, dependencies, and progress for leadership review

Identify and improve operational processes that span or connect the two IT organizations to increase overall efficiency and effectiveness

Decision Support & Executive Communications

Synthesize complex information from across both IT organizations and the broader business to inform leadership decisions and recommendations

Lead development of executive presentations, strategic briefings, and business updates on behalf of both VP leaders

Translate technical and operational content into clear, compelling narratives for business and executive audiences

Prepare both VP leaders for high-stakes meetings, technology reviews, and partner forums

Manage strategic communications flowing from both IT organizations to internal teams and business partners

Financial & Resource Planning Partnership

Partner with Finance to ensure budget planning, forecasting, and expense management processes across both IT organizations are well-coordinated and accurately represented to leadership

Maintain leadership-level visibility into headcount, resource allocation, and workforce planning across both portfolios in partnership with HR

Support both VP leaders in making informed resource prioritization decisions aligned with organizational strategy and demand

Track and flag material variances in budget or resource plans across either organization with appropriate context and recommended actions

Performance Visibility & Insights

Oversee tracking and reporting of key performance indicators spanning both the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience portfolios

Ensure both VP leaders have timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into organizational performance through consolidated dashboards and scorecards

Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across both organizations and bring them forward with context and perspective

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long‑term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

The RoleHIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance.Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management.Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems.Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues.Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party.Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team.Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.Job RequirementsThe following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

Identity resolution and matchingDesign and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches.Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization.Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system’s local key and the canonical party identifier.Golden record and survivorshipDesign golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage.Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production.Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.Party and relationship data modelingModel the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data.Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid.Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.Data quality and stewardshipBuild automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication.Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient.Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.Integration and pipelinesDesign inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems.Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency.Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.Cloud data platformBuild on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold.Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.Graph engineeringImplement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier.Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.Programming and platformsStrong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services.Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product.Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.Security, governance, and regulatoryBuild for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship.Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately.Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed.Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background.Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept.Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity.Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity.Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination.AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master.Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo).A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience.Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.CertificationsCertifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

jobs.description:
Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks ®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Summary

 Palo Alto Networks is looking for an experienced and motivated Domain Consultant with a passion for endpoint security controls that protect the workforce from attacks. This engineer will work closely with our sales team and ultimately be responsible for the technical “win” during the sales cycle. The Domain Consultant – Endpoint must demonstrate value during presentations, articulate technical challenges, pair with Palo Alto Networks solutions, and provide technical knowledge and experience to earn customer trust.

 Palo Alto Networks Endpoint Privilege Manager (part of the Idira platform), a critical and foundational endpoint control addresses the underlying weaknesses of endpoint defenses against a privileged attacker and helps enterprises defend against these attacks.

 Palo Alto Networks Domain Consultants work with the sales organization and are responsible for establishing the value of Palo Alto Networks products to prospective and current customers through demos, presentations, meetings, and proofs of concepts (POCs). Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

Responsibilities

- Build and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations to create excitement around Palo Alto Networks technology. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.

- Plan and execute POC evaluations of Palo Alto Networks products with prospective customers. Use your sales experience to position Palo Alto Networks ’s value and differentiators to acquire the technical win.

- Document customer interactions in Salesforce.

- Collect and deliver constant feedback to Palo Alto Networks ’s product management team to influence product direction and champion the voice of your customers.

- Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.

- Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

 Qualifications

- Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).

- Prior experience working primarily with endpoint/workstation products or solutions in a sales capacity.

- Hands-on experience with endpoint and identity management technologies such as: Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf and endpoint troubleshooting.

- Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- An understanding of security concepts and the development of security roles within organizations that meet functional, technical and regulatory requirements.

- Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.

- Proven ability to run technical discovery, design solutions, deliver demonstrations, answer RFPs and support complex sales opportunities.

- Travel as needed (<30%).

- Experience navigating enterprise-scale sales cycles preferred.

- Experience working with restAPIs with scripts or other no code/low code systems

 Compensation Disclosure

 The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.
 - /yr
Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
🔥 ¿Te motiva proteger entornos críticos, diseñar despliegues avanzados de EndPoint y liderar proyectos de XDR y SIEM que marcan la diferencia en grandes organizaciones?

En **Clober** buscamos reforzar nuestro equipo incorporando perfiles de **Cybersecurity Consultant -- EndPoint, XDR \& SIEM**. Si te apasiona la seguridad en endpoints, la detección y respuesta ante amenazas y las plataformas XDR/SIEM, este es tu sitio.

Formarás parte del Área de Cybersecurity, dentro de la BU de Cloud \& Cybersecurity, trabajando en un entorno colaborativo, ágil y orientado a la excelencia técnica.

🧑💼 **¿Qué harás en tu día a día?**

• Configurar y administrar soluciones EDR, ejecutando proyectos de despliegue en puestos de usuario, servidores y dispositivos móviles.

• Configurar y administrar soluciones XDR/SIEM, integrándolas con tecnologías de terceros como firewalls, proxys, balanceadores o soluciones antispam.

• Automatizar procesos de seguridad para la detección y respuesta ante incidentes mediante scripting y herramientas de automatización (valorable XSOAR).

• Integrar y mantener herramientas de seguridad dentro de un SOC, optimizando la capacidad de respuesta ante incidentes.

🧑 💼 **Perfil que buscamos**

• Profesional con entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en roles de ingeniería de sistemas y seguridad.

• Buen nivel de inglés, hablado y escrito.

• Ingeniería en Ciberseguridad o similar.

✨ **Requisitos y conocimientos deseables**

• Sólida experiencia en el diseño y despliegue de soluciones EDR y XDR/SIEM.

• Dominio de plataformas EDR/XDR como CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Trellix, Trend Micro, entre otras.

• Experiencia con plataformas SIEM como Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, Fortinet o Palo Alto.

• Capacidad de automatización mediante scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

• Conocimientos en firewalls, IDS/IPS, cifrado y gestión de identidades.

• Experiencia en soluciones SOAR (valorable Cortex XSOAR).

• Se valorarán certificaciones como CEH, CISSP, GCIH y certificaciones específicas de fabricantes (Splunk, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Fortinet, etc.).

**◼️🔵** **¿Quiénes somos?**

Clober está especializada en Cloud y Ciberseguridad y combina la agilidad y enfoque experto de una unidad altamente especializada con la solidez y experiencia global de SATEC. Este enfoque nos permite ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas modernas, sin dependencias innecesarias y con una visión a largo plazo, orientadas a la ejecución eficaz de proyectos complejos.

En Clober trabajamos desde la especialización real, diseñando, protegiendo y operando entornos tecnológicos de forma continua, siempre alineados con las necesidades de negocio y presupuesto de nuestros clientes. Entendemos la seguridad como un pilar desde la fase de diseño, lo que nos permite minimizar riesgos y garantizar decisiones coherentes desde el inicio.

Respaldados por años de experiencia en entornos críticos, acompañamos a nuestros clientes más allá de la implantación, aportando valor sostenido y capacidad real de ejecución.

**En Clober, la diversidad es una seña de identidad. Promovemos la igualdad y la equidad, creando un entorno libre e inclusivo donde las personas puedan desarrollar todo su potencial.**

**Responsabilidades**

* Ejecutar las tareas de operación y mantenimiento diario de los controles de seguridad de endpoints (incluyendo EDR, Antimalware, FIM, DLP de Endpoint, etc.) en ambientes on-premise y cloud, para asegurar la protección continua de los activos críticos y la información de la organización.

* Colaborar con equipos técnicos (SOC, Ingeniería de Detección, infraestructura, cloud, DevOps, aplicaciones) para configurar y optimizar los controles de seguridad de endpoints, asegurando la alineación con los objetivos de seguridad.

**Perfil Deseado**

* Enfoque Operativo: El área se dedica a la operación técnica diaria, brindando seguridad y soporte directo a los puntos finales (endpoints).
* Experiencia con: Controles de Endpoints: Consolas de gestión de EDR, Antimalware, FIM (Monitoreo de Integridad de Archivos) y DLP de Endpoint.
* CrowdStrike (EDR principal): Se requiere como mínimo un año de experiencia en su implementación u operación

- Design and maintain zero-touch provisioning and automated deployment solutions

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Endpoint Security & XDR
jobs.summary: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500,...
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing

- Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.

- Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

- Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.

- Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.

- Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

- Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.

- Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.

- Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring

- Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.

- Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.

- Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.

- A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.

- A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.

- A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.

- Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points

- Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.

- Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.

- Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.

- Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.

- A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.

- Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

 $192,500 - $304,500 CAD

 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
