jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing

- Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.

- Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

- Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.

- Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.

- Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

- Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.

- Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.

- Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring

- Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.

- Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.

- Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.

- A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.

- A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.

- A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.

- Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points

- Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.

- Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.

- Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.

- Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.

- A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.

- Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

 The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

 These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

 An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

 $199,700 - $315,900 USD

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:

 $239,800 - $379,300 USD

 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

jobs.description:
#### Company description

Meritis is an IT consulting, management, and development firm founded in 2007, with offices in Paris, Sophia-Antipolis, Aix-en-Provence, Montpellier, Toulouse, Nantes... And soon in new territories! Our mission? To connect the best talent with companies to give them a competitive edge.

We support our clients in all their digital transformation needs across numerous areas of expertise: Software Engineering, Finance, Project Management, Devops, Data, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Agility.

Operating in sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Telecommunications, Industry, and Transport, 40% of CAC40 companies are now Meritis clients.

Driven by our values of excellence, humility, kindness, and proximity, we now have over 900 employees.

We make it a point of honor to be close to our employees and to support them individually, regardless of their role in the company. Certified as a Great Place To Work since 2013, our concept of well-being at work goes far beyond a simple label; our employees describe it best: [https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Meritis-Avis-E1163008.htm](https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Meritis-Avis-E1163008.htm).

#### Job description

You will work for one of our clients in the specialized sports retail sector. As part of their infrastructure modernization, an initial project is underway with a service provider, and the goal is to extend this momentum to the store network.

Your main missions:

- Manage the service provider in charge of the scoping study: scoping the perimeter and workload, tracking the schedule and milestones, facilitating follow-up meetings, and resolving blockers.
- Challenge and secure the study deliverables (current state analysis, scenarios, target trajectory, prerequisites, costing, risk analysis) before client validation.
- Contribute to defining the migration trajectory for messaging from Exchange On-Premises to Exchange Online for the store perimeter.
- Contribute to defining the deployment scenario for the Microsoft 365 Apps suite across the store fleet (packaging, update channels, licenses, remote operation constraints).

#### Qualifications

- Microsoft 365: Exchange Online and migration from Exchange On-Premises, Microsoft 365 Apps (deployment, licenses, update channels), tenant administration.
- Identity and Access Management: Active Directory, Entra ID, Entra Connect, identity models, and privileged account management.
- Windows 10 / 11 workstation: domain or Entra ID joining, master and packaging, management via Intune and/or SCCM, patch management.
- Workstation security: removal of local administrator rights, handling of generic accounts, and automatic login.
- Multi-site environments such as store networks: network constraints, remote operation, absence of local IT support.
- Project and service provider management: planning, deliverable review, risk management, reporting, and governance.

#### Additional information

Becoming a Meritis employee means:

- Tailor-made professional paths (career development, adapted training, mentoring...);
- Having a choice of mission and personalized support throughout your career;
- Evolving in an environment where learning is encouraged: certifying training, e-learning, meetups, coding competitions, development paths, etc.;
- Being part of expert communities that share their knowledge and experience within our centers of excellence;
- A friendly environment with numerous festive events (annual party, seminars & teambuilding, lunches, and afterworks...);

_"Meritis is committed to Corporate Social Responsibility. We value our positive impact on society and the environment. Our CSR approach guides each of our actions to promote equity, sustainability, and the well-being of our employees. Join us to be part of this responsible approach, where each of our talents contributes to building a better future._

_Our differences are our strengths. That is why Meritis is committed to diversity and non-discrimination. All our positions are accessible to people with disabilities."

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you’ll do at Jamf :

The Consulting Engineer's (CE) primary role is to partner within Sales and other departments to achieve sales and revenue goals, serving as technical authority and escalation resource for complex opportunities. This role blends deep Apple ecosystem expertise with advanced security knowledge across endpoint protection, identity management, and network security, enabling you to design and deliver integrated enterprise solutions that drive innovation and support our customers beyond traditional device management. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams, as well as industry partners, to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for enterprise environments.

 This position is only available internally for employees located in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France. We are only able to accept applications for those based in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France and have sponsorship to live and work in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France #Li-Remote

What you can expect to do in this role:

- Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and vision of the organization

- Provide technical consultation and technical escalation for Sales and other departments

- Serve as technical escalation resource for Sales Engineers on complex, strategic opportunities requiring advanced architecture expertise or executive engagement

- Continuously update expertise and demonstrate deep understanding of subject matter specific to role assignment, including but not limited to:

  - Architecture of Jamf 's comprehensive platform solutions: Jamf for Mac, Jamf for Mobile, Jamf for K-12, and Jamf for Small Business

  - Architecture of Android device management and security solutions

  - Architecture of identity management solutions leveraging Platform SSO and enterprise directory integration

  - Architecture of enterprise security infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, IAM platforms)

  - Architecture of Apple-centric zero-trust network frameworks such as Managed Device Attestation and WireGuard

  - Architecture of cross-platform security frameworks for enterprise environments

  - Architecture of Apple and Android-centric security frameworks for enterprise environments

  - Understanding of common and emerging threat vectors and risks specific to Apple and Android enterprise environments

  - Architecture of advanced Jamf configurations including automation frameworks and API integrations

  - Custom workflows and automation for large-scale enterprise deployments

- Lead response to complex RFPs requiring comprehensive Apple enterprise expertise

- Deliver technical presentations and executive workshops for enterprise prospects and customers

- Collaborate with Sales, Professional Services, and Product teams to architect custom Apple enterprise solutions spanning management, endpoint security, and network security

- Build and maintain strategic partner relationships with complementary solution providers (Apple, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Okta)

- Develop and deliver internal training and knowledge transfer on Apple enterprise best practices and emerging capabilities

- Create reusable implementation templates, automation tools, and methodologies for Apple enterprise deployments

- Serve as an escalation point for Sales, Marketing, and Product teams on Apple enterprise matters

- Represent Jamf as an Apple enterprise expert at industry events, conferences, and community forums

- Drive innovation initiatives to address gaps in current solutions or where no solution exists

- Contribute to product roadmap through field feedback and customer requirements

- Active participation in professional development opportunities and industry training

- Understand cross-platform integration scenarios and coexistence strategies in enterprise environments

- Special projects assigned by management

What are we looking for:

- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Apple device management, endpoint and/or network security (Required)

- Experience working in consultative sales, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales support roles (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Apple Enterprise Management technologies, endpoint protection, identity management, and zero-trust network architectures (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Jamf products and solutions (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of IT ecosystem and key partner integrations/complementary solutions including but not limited to Apple, Okta, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, SIEM/SOAR (Preferred)

- Specialized expertise in minimum 2 of the following areas: endpoint security architectures, identity and access management, zero-trust network architectures, SIEM/SOAR integration, API development and automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code, emerging technologies (AI/ML, Apple Intelligence) (Preferred)

- Familiarity with scripting and automation languages (Go, Python, PowerShell, bash, Terraform, Ansible) and Apple developer languages (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Apple SDKs, Xcode) (Preferred)

- Experience responding to RFPs and developing comprehensive solution proposals (Required)

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executives and decision-makers (Required)

- Strong workshop and facilitation skills to align technical and business stakeholders (Preferred)

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English (Required)

- Comfortable engaging with a wide range of personnel, from technical to executive positions (Required)

- Experience identifying solution gaps, ability to propose innovations, and execute subsequent implementation strategies (Preferred)

- Active participation in the Apple enterprise community including conferences, forums, user groups, thought leadership content, or public speaking (Preferred)

Education and certifications

- Secondary school diploma or equivalent (Required)

- 4 Year / Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Preferred)

  - A combination of professional relevant experience and education may be considered

-
 Jamf Certifications 300, 370, 400 (Preferred)

- Relevant partner or security certifications aligned with focus area (Preferred)

- Commitment to maintaining current certifications and pursuing emerging technology education

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf .

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to travel for customer visits, conferences, or internal events approximately 20% of the year

- Flexible working hours may be required to accommodate regional business needs and collaboration with global teams

How we help you reach your best potential:

- We’re so proud to announce we've been named in @G2's 2025 Best Software Awards for:

🏆 Best Software for Enterprise Business

🏆 Best Software for Mid-Market Business

🏆 Best Software Companies
🏆 Best IT Management Software Products

-
 Jamf is a 2024 TrustRadius Tech Cares Award Winner!

-

 Jamf Protect has received the honor of Endpoint Security Solution of the Year in

CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards, 2022.

-
 Jamf Protect received the Security Software Solution of the Year, and Jamf Threat Defense has earned the title of Mobile Security Solution of the Year, in the 2022 Computer Security Awards.

 What it means to be a Jamf ?We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

 Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

 Above it all, waves our banner of #One Jamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

  What does Jamf do? Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf , customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

 Get social with us and follow the conversation at #One Jamf

   Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. jobs.description:
Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.

  Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

  The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior IT Security System Administrator to own both sides of a critical mandate: keeping our systems running reliably and keeping them secure. This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting directly to the IT Director. You'll split your time roughly equally between systems administration Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity, and SaaS platforms) and security operations (policy enforcement, access control, compliance, threat monitoring, and incident response).

You'll be the person who implements, monitors, and enforces security controls across a rapidly growing distributed workforce. The ideal candidate is technically sharp, operationally disciplined, and comfortable owning both the "does it work" and "is it safe" questions simultaneously. This role is essential for maintaining the reliability, performance, and security of our systems.

  What You Will Own

- Administer Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 environments, while facilitating the setup and full migration to Microsoft 365.

- Manage a mix of Windows and Mac endpoints using MDM tools for device enrollment, configuration, compliance, and patch management policies.

- Administer SSO, MFA, and directory integrations; maintain identity provider configuration and authentication policy.

- Administer and manage security toolsets (DLP, EDR, email security, and SIEM logs) to ensure effective threat detection and policy enforcement.

- Provide tier 2/3 support for firm-wide SaaS applications as necessary.

- Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, email, identity, and cloud environments.

- Support compliance activities and internal audits; maintain evidence and documentation for security controls.

- Contribute to incident response: detection, containment, remediation, and post-incident review.

- Assist with vulnerability management, including patch cadence tracking and endpoint hygiene reporting.

- Identify gaps in security coverage or operational process and drive remediation.

- Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices relevant to a remote-first professional services environment.

- Develop dashboards & reports for security metrics, compliance status, and operational health.

- Manage relationships with key vendors and service providers, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.

- Oversee security operations and ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and internal policies.

- Strategy and planning: Translate business needs into operational capability, capacity planning, DR/BCP design, cloud migration strategy, and lifecycle roadmaps.

  What You Bring

  Required:

- Minimum of 7 years experience in IT systems administration, security, operations, or a combined role.

- Proven expertise in managing modern, complex IT environments.

- Enterprise level collaboration suite administration experience (Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace)

- Security fundamentals: Identity/access controls, patching, vulnerability management, and secure configuration practices.

- Disaster recovery & backups: Design and testable DR plans, RTO/RPO understanding, and backup validation.

- Working knowledge of EDR, email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing), DLP, or SIEM tooling in an operational capacity

- Hands-on MDM/UEM experience across Mac and Windows (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent); comfortable managing device compliance at scale

- Demonstrated experience administering SSO, MFA, and an identity provider (Okta, Google Identity, Azure AD / Entra ID, or equivalent)

- Solid understanding of security fundamentals: identity lifecycle management, endpoint hygiene, phishing defense, zero-trust principles

- Experience supporting a fully remote or distributed workforce.

- Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

  Preferred (Nice to Have):

- Experience in a law firm, legal technology, or professional services environment.

- Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST CSF, or similar).

- Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing a team of IT professionals.

- Understanding of monitoring and logging tools (i.e. Nagios, Splunk, ELK stack).

- Scripting or automation experience (n8n, Python, Bash, Google Apps Script).

- Experience with cloud security posture management or SaaS security review.

- Demonstrated experience with disaster recovery planning and testing.

  Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

-
  Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

-
  Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

-
  No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

-
  Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

-
  Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  What We Offer

- Base Salary: $115,000 and $135,000 per year, commensurate with experience

- Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

- Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks ®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Summary

 Palo Alto Networks is looking for an experienced and motivated solutions engineer with a passion for endpoint security controls that protect the workforce from attacks. This engineer will work closely with our sales team and ultimately be responsible for the technical “win” during the sales cycle. The Domain Consultant – Endpoint must demonstrate value during presentations, articulate technical challenges, pair with Palo Alto Networks solutions, and provide technical knowledge and experience to earn customer trust.

 Palo Alto Networks Endpoint Privilege Manager (part of the Idira platform), a critical and foundational endpoint control addresses the underlying weaknesses of endpoint defenses against a privileged attacker and helps enterprises defend against these attacks.

 Palo Alto Networks Domain Consultants work with the sales organization and are responsible for establishing the value of Palo Alto Networks products to prospective and current customers through demos, presentations, meetings, and proofs of concepts (POCs). Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

Responsibilities

- Build and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations to create excitement around Palo Alto Networks technology. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.

- Plan and execute POC evaluations of Palo Alto Networks products with prospective customers. Use your sales experience to position Palo Alto Networks ’s value and differentiators to acquire the technical win.

- Document customer interactions in Salesforce.

- Collect and deliver constant feedback to Palo Alto Networks ’s product management team to influence product direction and champion the voice of your customers.

- Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.

- Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

- Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).

- Prior experience working primarily with endpoint/workstation products or solutions in a sales capacity.

- Hands-on experience with endpoint and identity management technologies such as: Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf and endpoint troubleshooting.

- Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- An understanding of security concepts and the development of security roles within organizations that meet functional, technical and regulatory requirements.

- Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.

- Proven ability to run technical discovery, design solutions, deliver demonstrations, answer RFPs and support complex sales opportunities.

- Travel as needed (<30%).

- Experience navigating enterprise-scale sales cycles preferred.

- Experience working with restAPIs with scripts or other no code/low code systems

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.
$198,000.00 - $273,000.00/yr
Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Title

Digital Workplace AV Support Engineer

Location

Bethlehem, PA. This role requires travel to other Guardian locations including Hudson Yards (NYC), Holmdel, NJ, and additional sites as needed (up to 25%). Occasional off-hours and weekend support is required.

Job Summary

Guardian is seeking a highly capable AV Support Engineer to join the Digital Workplace organization. This role is responsible for delivering reliable, high-touch audiovisual and collaboration support across conference rooms, executive meeting spaces, and enterprise event environments.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms and modern hybrid collaboration technologies. The position requires strong technical depth, composure under pressure, and the ability to resolve issues in real time during business-critical meetings and events.

The ideal candidate operates independently, partners effectively across IT, Facilities, and vendors, and takes ownership of delivering a consistent, high-quality meeting experience across all locations.

Key Responsibilities

AV and Collaboration Support

Provide onsite and remote support for conference rooms, boardrooms, training rooms, and hybrid collaboration spacesSupport Microsoft Teams Rooms and related AV technologies including cameras, microphones, DSPs, displays, and control systemsPerform real-time troubleshooting during live meetings, minimizing disruption and ensuring a seamless experienceConduct pre-meeting room validation checks to ensure readiness and reliability

Event and Executive Support

Deliver white-glove support for executive meetings, town halls, and enterprise eventsManage end-to-end AV support including setup, testing, live operation, and teardownPartner with business stakeholders and event organizers to define requirements and ensure successful executionSupport live and hybrid events including streaming, recording, and broadcast workflows

End User Support And Experience

Support collaboration tools including Microsoft Teams and related conferencing platformsProvide direct assistance to end users, including executives, ensuring a high-quality and consistent meeting experienceDeliver basic user guidance and training on AV and meeting technologies

AV Operations and Reliability

Perform routine health checks, preventative maintenance, and system validation across AV-enabled spacesMonitor and troubleshoot recurring issues; perform root cause analysis and recommend long-term fixesMaintain high availability and performance of AV systems aligned to business expectationsTrack incidents, resolutions, and trends to improve service quality and reduce repeat issues

Engineering Collaboration and Standards

Partner with engineering teams to standardize room designs, configurations, and support modelsAssist with AV deployments, upgrades, and lifecycle management across sitesReview vendor installations to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and quality expectationsCreate and maintain documentation including room standards, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides

Vendor and Stakeholder Management

Act as a key point of contact for AV vendors, integrators, and service providersCoordinate installations, repairs, and maintenance activitiesWork closely with Facilities and Real Estate teams to support workspace technology initiatives

Security and Compliance

Ensure AV and collaboration technologies align with enterprise security and compliance requirementsPartner with Security and Infrastructure teams to maintain secure configurationsSupport audit and risk management activities as needed

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve the user experience, system reliability, and operational efficiencyRecommend enhancements through automation, monitoring, and standardizationStay current on emerging AV, collaboration, and hybrid workplace technologies

Qualifications

Experience

8–10 years of IT experience, with at least 5 years focused on AV, video conferencingProven experience supporting enterprise conference rooms, collaboration environments, and live eventsExperience in multi-site or campus environments strongly preferred

Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Rooms and enterprise collaboration platformsDeep knowledge of AV hardware including cameras, microphones, speakers, displays, and control systemsUnderstanding of AV signal flow, cabling, and AV-over-IP conceptsExperience troubleshooting integrated AV/IT environments and network-connected systemsFamiliarity with AV management, monitoring, and asset tracking tools

Professional Skills

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, especially under time pressure during live eventsAbility to operate independently and manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environmentsExcellent communication skills with the ability to support both technical and non-technical stakeholdersCustomer-focused mindset with an emphasis on delivering a high-quality user experienceHigh attention to detail and accountability for outcomes

Additional Preferred Skills

Experience supporting large-scale AV environments across multiple locationsExposure to incident management, escalation handling, and IT service management frameworksExperience documenting standards, runbooks, and operational proceduresBackground in hybrid meeting support, live event production, or streaming technologiesRelevant certifications such as AVIXA CTS or vendor-specific AV certifications preferred but not required

Why This Role Matters

This role sits at the intersection of technology and user experience. You will directly impact how employees collaborate, communicate, and engage—particularly in high-visibility meetings where reliability and professionalism are critical. Modern AV environments are tightly integrated with enterprise IT systems, requiring a blend of AV expertise, networking knowledge, and customer-centric execution.

jobs.summary: About The Role You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer - configure it, connect it, and keep...
jobs.description:
About The Role

You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer - configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You'll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

What You'll Do

Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee - ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows - exception queues, match review, and record correction.Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.Monitor MDM pipeline health - match rates, queue depth, golden record lag - and fix issues when they arise.Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

Must-Have

3+ years with Profisee MDM - you've implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.Strong SQL and Python - you can write and debug pipeline code independently.Profisee integration experience - connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.Match/merge configuration - candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.Cloud environment experience - AWS or Azure.

Nice to Have

Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).Financial services domain knowledge - client data, advisor data, accounts.Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

You're a Good Fit If

You can configure a Profisee match rule from scratch and explain why you set the thresholds where you did.You've debugged a golden record that wasn't writing back correctly and can walk through how you found the issue.You don't need someone to hand you an architecture diagram before you can ask good questions.

VIATEQ Corporation is looking for a Junior Endpoint Protection Analyst to support enterprise cybersecurity operations and IT administrative support services for a federal government client. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a government background investigation, PIV credentials, and all requisite IT access authorizations prior to performing work. Primary work will be performed at the client site in Washington, DC and approved remote/telework locations.

This role serves as an important technical support function responsible for assisting in the administration, monitoring, and maintenance of enterprise endpoint security controls and endpoint protection platforms across a complex, geographically distributed federal IT environment spanning on-premises infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic and detail-oriented early-career cybersecurity professional with foundational knowledge of endpoint security technologies, security operations practices, and Federal cybersecurity compliance requirements. This individual must possess a strong desire to learn and grow within a dynamic federal IT security environment, a collaborative mindset, and the technical foundation necessary to support the administration and monitoring of enterprise endpoint protection capabilities under the guidance of senior security personnel.

The Junior Endpoint Protection Analyst will serve as a supporting technical contributor within the program's cybersecurity team, assisting senior security engineers and analysts in the day-to-day administration, monitoring, and maintenance of enterprise endpoint security controls and endpoint protection platforms. This individual supports the protection of Government endpoints—including workstations, laptops, servers, and mobile devices—against malware, unauthorized access, policy violations, and other security threats, contributing to the program's broader mission of maintaining a strong and continuously improving enterprise security posture in alignment with Federal cybersecurity frameworks and client security requirements.

Responsibilities:
Endpoint Protection Platform Administration:

Assist in the administration and maintenance of enterprise endpoint protection platforms, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), antivirus, anti-malware, host-based intrusion detection, application control, and device management solutions under the guidance of senior security engineers.Support the configuration, deployment, and management of endpoint security agents across managed endpoints, ensuring agent coverage is comprehensive, current, and accurately tracked.Monitor endpoint protection platform dashboards and consoles, identifying endpoints with outdated agents, missing security policies, protection gaps, or active threats requiring investigation or remediation.Assist in the development and maintenance of endpoint security policies, configurations, and deployment packages, ensuring policies are aligned with applicable security baselines, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and client security requirements.Support the management of endpoint protection platform exceptions, exclusions, and whitelists, ensuring all exceptions are properly documented, reviewed, and approved in accordance with defined governance procedures.Assist in the administration and maintenance of Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platforms, supporting the enrollment, configuration, monitoring, and compliance enforcement of managed mobile and remote devices.Generate and distribute endpoint protection platform health and coverage reports, providing program leadership and Government stakeholders with accurate visibility into endpoint security posture and protection gaps.
Threat Detection & Alert Monitoring:

Monitor endpoint protection platform alerts, EDR telemetry, and security event feeds, triaging security alerts and escalating confirmed or suspected security incidents to senior analysts and the incident response team in accordance with defined escalation procedures and SLA requirements.Assist in the investigation of endpoint security alerts, gathering relevant event data, endpoint telemetry, and contextual information to support accurate triage and escalation decisions under the guidance of senior security personnel.Support the development and maintenance of endpoint alert triage procedures, escalation playbooks, and response runbooks, contributing practical observations and lessons learned from daily monitoring activities.Assist in identifying and documenting false positive alert patterns, supporting senior engineers in refining detection rules, alert thresholds, and EDR platform tuning to improve alert fidelity and reduce analyst fatigue.Monitor endpoint protection platform health and availability, identifying and escalating platform performance issues, service disruptions, and coverage gaps that may impact the program's ability to detect and respond to endpoint threats.
Vulnerability & Patch Management Support:

Assist in the execution of endpoint vulnerability scanning activities, supporting the scheduling, execution, and result collection of regular vulnerability scans across managed endpoints using enterprise vulnerability scanning platforms.Support the analysis and triage of endpoint vulnerability scan results, assisting senior engineers in identifying, categorizing, and prioritizing vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and asset criticality under defined risk-based prioritization criteria.Assist in tracking and reporting on endpoint patch compliance status, monitoring patch deployment progress across managed endpoints and identifying systems with outstanding critical and high-severity patches requiring escalation.Support coordination with system administrators and desktop support personnel to facilitate timely endpoint patch deployment, providing technical assistance and escalation support as needed.Maintain accurate and current endpoint vulnerability and patch compliance records in the program's vulnerability management tracking system, supporting audit readiness and compliance reporting activities.
Endpoint Hardening & Compliance:

Assist in the implementation and validation of endpoint hardening standards, supporting the application of DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and client-specific security baselines across managed Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoint environments.Support configuration compliance scanning activities, assisting in the execution and analysis of Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) scans and configuration compliance assessments across managed endpoints.Assist in tracking and reporting on endpoint configuration compliance status, identifying non-compliant endpoints and supporting remediation activities to bring endpoints into compliance with applicable security baselines.Support the development and maintenance of endpoint hardening documentation, including hardening guides, configuration baseline specifications, and compliance reporting templates.
Incident Response Support:

Support cybersecurity incident response activities involving endpoint security events, assisting senior analysts and engineers in evidence collection, endpoint isolation, malware containment, and remediation activities under defined incident response procedures.Assist in the collection and preservation of endpoint forensic evidence, supporting chain of custody procedures and forensic acquisition activities under the guidance of senior digital forensics or incident response personnel.Document incident response activities accurately and completely in the program's ITSM platform, ensuring incident records contain sufficient detail to support post-incident review, root cause analysis, and lessons learned activities.Support post-incident review activities, contributing endpoint security observations and technical findings to root cause analysis discussions and corrective action development.
Compliance & Documentation Support:

Assist in maintaining endpoint security compliance documentation, including security control implementation evidence, configuration compliance records, vulnerability remediation tracking data, and audit artifacts, supporting the program's ATO and continuous monitoring obligations.Support the development and maintenance of endpoint security standard operating procedures, operational runbooks, and knowledge base articles, contributing practical operational knowledge to the program's documentation library.Assist in the preparation of endpoint security status reports, compliance dashboards, and metrics summaries for program leadership and Government stakeholders.Ensure all endpoint security activities are conducted in compliance with applicable Federal regulations, client security policies, and program security requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, applicable DISA STIGs, and client-specific cybersecurity policies.Ensure all activities involving personally identifiable information (PII), CUI, or other sensitive data categories are handled in accordance with applicable privacy protection requirements and data handling restrictions.
Professional Development & Learning:

Actively pursue professional development and skills growth in endpoint security, cybersecurity operations, and Federal IT compliance, leveraging available training resources, mentorship from senior team members, and industry certifications to continuously expand technical capabilities.Participate in team knowledge sharing sessions, security briefings, and technical training activities, contributing to a collaborative learning environment within the cybersecurity team.Stay current with emerging endpoint security threats, vulnerabilities, attacker TTPs, and evolving Federal cybersecurity requirements, incorporating new knowledge into daily monitoring and analysis activities.

jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are---with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action---enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Extensive experience managing Windows endpoint operating systems, including security features, configuration management, and compliance controls
* Strong knowledge of vulnerability management lifecycle processes, including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation, and validation of security risks
* Proven expertise administering Microsoft Intune to configure endpoint policies, deploy operating system updates, and maintain device compliance
* Experience using vulnerability and patch management platforms such as Qualys to analyze security findings and drive remediation activities
* Proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash scripting to automate endpoint management, patch deployment, and remediation processes
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex endpoint, deployment, and compliance issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage technical teams and business users to support remediation efforts and improve endpoint security posture
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in endpoint management, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or a related systems engineering role
* Relevant certifications in endpoint management, Microsoft Intune, Qualys, PowerShell, Windows, macOS, or related technologies are preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Manage endpoint vulnerability remediation and patch management activities to maintain secure, compliant, and reliable Windows and macOS environments.
* Manage and maintain the security baseline of Windows and macOS endpoints to ensure performance, security, and compliance with organizational standards
* Develop, implement, and manage operating system and security patch deployment processes using endpoint management and vulnerability management tools
* Perform vulnerability scans, analyze remediation requirements, and implement corrective actions while minimizing disruption to end-user productivity
* Partner with Information Technology and Cyber Security teams to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with security policies and compliance requirements
* Monitor, track, and report on patch compliance and vulnerability remediation progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders
* Develop and enhance automation scripts to improve the efficiency, consistency, and reliability of patching and remediation activities
* Troubleshoot endpoint management, patch deployment, and policy enforcement issues to ensure successful implementation across the environment
* Communicate effectively with business users to support vulnerability remediation efforts, including targeted outreach and follow-up for non-compliant devices and participation in planned maintenance, on-call support, and security initiatives as needed

**About The Team** Our Technology Infrastructure and Endpoint Management team is responsible for maintaining secure, reliable, and compliant endpoint environments across the organization. The team works closely with Cyber Security, Information Technology, and business stakeholders to strengthen the organization's security posture through proactive vulnerability management, operating system patching, endpoint governance, and operational excellence. By joining this team, you will contribute to critical security initiatives, leverage modern automation and endpoint management technologies, and help advance the adoption of innovative solutions that improve efficiency and support responsible use of emerging technologies.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

  OT SYSTEMS ENGINEER, PROPELLANT GENERATION & INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS

 SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms critical to our launch, manufacturing, and commodities generation environments. This role is embedded within the mission IT organization to provide support to dedicated controls engineering organizations while leveraging adjacent IT expertise, tooling, and technologies. This role will balance support of legacy controls support systems with modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in high-stakes settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and combines deep OT expertise with IT technologies such as virtualization, VDI, GitOps, network-level redundancy and edge compute solutions to create streamlined and secure ICS environments.

  RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.

- Install, configure, maintain, and support industry-standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.

- Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.

- Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.

- Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.

- Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).

- Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.

- Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.

- Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.

- Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

  BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration; OR 5+ years of professional experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration in lieu of a degree.

- Experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.

- Experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.

  PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Demonstrated project management experience leading multiple concurrent projects from planning through execution and closeout, including scope definition, scheduling, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional engineering and operations teams.

- Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.

- Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.

- Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.

- Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.

- System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.

- Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

  ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

- Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

- Ability to lift 30 lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Ability to drive (active valid driver's license).

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.description:
We're looking for an End User Computing Manager to build and improve the workplace technology environment across EMCD.

We're looking for an End User Computing Manager to build and improve the workplace technology environment across EMCD . We need proactive and hands-on, who can own employee devices, corporate accounts, SaaS access, IAM, asset management, onboarding/offboarding automation, and the overall digital employee experience.

You'll work closely with Security, IT, vendors, and business teams to make sure employees have secure, reliable, and convenient access to the tools they need.

 Responsibilities:

- Own and improve the end-user technology environment: laptops, mobile devices, corporate accounts, SaaS access, Google Workspace, Slack

- Manage IAM, SSO, access policies, and secure access to key SaaS applications

- Build and automate onboarding/offboarding workflows, including account provisioning and access revocation

- Manage endpoint security and device lifecycle across remote and distributed teams

- Maintain asset management processes: hardware inventory, regular reviews, lifecycle replacement

- Oversee Service Desk and support operations, ensuring fast and high-quality issue resolution

- Manage vendors, SaaS providers, licenses, and contracts to avoid unused or overlapping tools

- Standardize EUC processes across the company and drive self-service, automation, and zero-touch provisioning

 Requirements:

- 7+ years in IT, including 3–5 years in End User Computing, Workplace Technology, IT Support Management, Client Services, or Desktop Engineering

- Strong hands-on experience with Google Workspace and Slack administration

- Experience with IAM, SSO, IdP, access management

- Experience with MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Google Endpoint Management, Workspace ONE, or similar

- Understanding of endpoint operating systems: macOS, Windows, mobile platforms

- Experience with ITSM processes and tools: incident, asset, change management; Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar

- Ability to work with vendors and managed service providers

- Proactive approach to identify problems and improve processes

 Nice to have:

- Certifications: Google Workspace Administrator, ITIL v4, Jamf Certified, PMP, or similar

- Experience with self-service portals, Slack bots, or automated IT workflows

- Experience standardizing user environments during M&A or company scaling

 What We Offer:

- Fully remote work from anywhere in the world

- Flexible working hours focused on results

- 20 working days of vacation + 12 additional bonus days

- Paid sick leave with no bureaucracy

- Compensation for courses, certifications, and training programs

- Real ownership of workplace technology in a fast-growing crypto ecosystem

jobs.description:
Company Description

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

 Job Description
Position Overview

WD is seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic partner and operational advisor jointly supporting the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience. This role sits at the intersection of two complementary IT organizations, connecting strategy to execution across both portfolios and ensuring the combined leadership team operates with shared clarity, alignment, and accountability.

The Chief of Staff works alongside both VP leaders to drive organizational priorities forward, maintain operational rhythm, and represent IT interests across cross-functional forums. Given the dual scope of this role, the ability to hold context across multiple domains, balance competing priorities thoughtfully, and build trust with two distinct leadership teams is essential. This is a high-visibility, high-trust role that requires sound judgment, executive presence, strong communication instincts, and the ability to operate effectively across a complex, matrixed global technology organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Enablement & Organizational Leadership

Partner with both the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience to develop, refine, and communicate IT strategic priorities across their respective organizations and to shared stakeholders

Translate strategy across both IT portfolios into actionable roadmaps, plans, and organizational commitments

Serve as a thought partner to both VP leaders on organizational decisions, planning trade-offs, and priority setting

Help identify opportunities for alignment, synergy, and shared execution across the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience organizations

Represent both VP leadership interests in cross-functional forums, planning sessions, and executive reviews as appropriate

Help shape and steward the IT organizational narrative across both domains, ensuring consistent messaging for internal and external audiences

Operational Execution & Cadence

Own the operating cadence across both IT organizations, including leadership team rhythms, QBRs, strategic planning cycles, and technology reviews

Drive accountability across both leadership teams for key commitments, deliverables, and milestones

Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, escalating or connecting stakeholders where needed

Maintain visibility into initiative portfolios across both organizations, surfacing risks, dependencies, and progress for leadership review

Identify and improve operational processes that span or connect the two IT organizations to increase overall efficiency and effectiveness

Decision Support & Executive Communications

Synthesize complex information from across both IT organizations and the broader business to inform leadership decisions and recommendations

Lead development of executive presentations, strategic briefings, and business updates on behalf of both VP leaders

Translate technical and operational content into clear, compelling narratives for business and executive audiences

Prepare both VP leaders for high-stakes meetings, technology reviews, and partner forums

Manage strategic communications flowing from both IT organizations to internal teams and business partners

Financial & Resource Planning Partnership

Partner with Finance to ensure budget planning, forecasting, and expense management processes across both IT organizations are well-coordinated and accurately represented to leadership

Maintain leadership-level visibility into headcount, resource allocation, and workforce planning across both portfolios in partnership with HR

Support both VP leaders in making informed resource prioritization decisions aligned with organizational strategy and demand

Track and flag material variances in budget or resource plans across either organization with appropriate context and recommended actions

Performance Visibility & Insights

Oversee tracking and reporting of key performance indicators spanning both the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience portfolios

Ensure both VP leaders have timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into organizational performance through consolidated dashboards and scorecards

Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across both organizations and bring them forward with context and perspective

Drive consistent, high-quality reporting practices across both IT organizations

Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Alignment

Serve as a primary coordination point bridging Business Applications, Digital Employee Experience, and other IT domains including Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Architecture

Build and maintain strong working relationships with key business partner organizations including Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and Operations

Facilitate alignment across shared IT priorities, service commitments, and technology roadmaps that span both VP organizations

Help navigate organizational complexity and resolve cross-functional friction points on behalf of both VP leaders

Organizational Health & Culture

Contribute to a healthy, high-performing culture across both IT organizations by modeling clarity, accountability, and inclusion in day-to-day operations

Support both VP leaders in communication efforts that keep their respective organizations informed, engaged, and connected to strategy

Help identify and address organizational gaps, team dynamics, and structural issues that may affect effectiveness across either portfolio

Champion continuous improvement across IT ways of working, team collaboration, and shared organizational practices

Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives

Lead or co-lead high-priority special projects on behalf of either or both VP leaders

Support transformation and modernization initiatives across both IT portfolios through research, analysis, coordination, and stakeholder engagement

Take end-to-end ownership of defined strategic workstreams from scoping through delivery

Provide analytical and strategic support for emerging priorities and leadership agenda items across both organizations

Scope & Impact

Operates as a direct extension of two IT VP leaders across strategic and operational matters spanning Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience

Regular engagement with VP and C-suite-level stakeholders across IT and the broader business

Cross-functional reach spanning multiple IT domains and major business partner organizations

Meaningful influence over how two distinct but complementary IT organizations operate, communicate, and deliver on shared and individual commitments across the enterprise

 Qualifications
Required

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field

8 or more years of progressive experience in IT strategy, IT operations, business operations, chief of staff, or senior program leadership roles

Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at the VP or executive level in a complex, matrixed organization

Proven ability to manage and balance competing priorities across multiple stakeholders and organizational contexts simultaneously

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a track record of executive-level storytelling and presentation development

Strong analytical capability with experience synthesizing data into strategic recommendations

Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive organizational information with care

Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities with composure and clarity in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

Experience in a formal Chief of Staff, Senior Director of Strategy, or equivalent advisory role within an enterprise IT organization

Background in technology, manufacturing, semiconductor, or related industries

Familiarity with IT financial management, portfolio planning, and vendor management practices

Experience supporting multiple VP or C-suite leaders concurrently within a global organization

Exposure to IT strategic planning, digital transformation, and organizational change management

Knowledge of ITIL, Agile, or related IT service and delivery frameworks

MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred
