jobs.description:
This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering, field/deskside support, and M365 and collaboration platform delivery through subordinate management. The Executive Director determines the organizational structure and operational direction for the function and participates with senior management in developing the strategic plans and objectives that govern it, ensuring the function's direction remains tied to company-wide performance and responds effectively to Regeneron's constantly changing business needs.

The Executive Director brings in-depth knowledge of the functional area, Regeneron's business strategies, and the company's goals to reposition employee-facing IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience. Decisions on strategy, investment, and operating model in this function have a measurable, long-term effect on employee productivity, cost-to-serve, and the company's ability to attract and retain talent — the Executive Director is expected to bring strength and clarity to the function during periods of growth or major change, and to lead effectively even where direction is ambiguous.

This is the next iteration of IT service delivery at Regeneron — evolving the function from a ticket- and SLA-driven operation into a proactive, experience-led organization measured on employee sentiment, self-service adoption, and time-to-resolution, not just uptime. The Executive Director partners closely with Enterprise Architecture on technical standards and platform decisions, and with IT Strategy & Transformation, which sponsors chartered modernization initiatives into this tower without assuming direct reporting authority.

Where and When

This is an on-site position 4 days/week, primarily based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ office. If eligible, we can offer relocation benefits; we cannot offer a fully remote option.

What You'll Lead

Employee Technology Strategy & Digital Experience Vision

Participate with senior IT and business leadership in developing the strategic plans and objectives for employee technology, ensuring the function's direction stays tied to company-wide performance and adapts to constantly changing business needs. Define and own the vision, roadmap, and operating model for Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, positioning IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience rather than a traditional service organization. Translate employee and business feedback into a prioritized modernization roadmap across service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and lifecycle technology. Champion a "digital-first, self-service-first" philosophy, shifting volume away from live support and toward intuitive, automated, and AI-enabled experiences. Partner with IT Strategy & Transformation to align sponsored modernization initiatives (e.g., virtual agent/AI deflection, unified employee portal) with this tower's operational roadmap and capacity. Service Desk & ITSM Operations (ServiceNow)

Own end-to-end Service Desk operations, including tiered support, major incident management, and escalation processes across a global, follow-the-sun model. Drive continuous modernization of the ServiceNow platform — intelligent routing, virtual agent/chatbot deflection, knowledge management, and workflow automation — to reduce ticket volume and resolution time. Establish and monitor experience-led metrics (CSAT, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, mean time to resolve) as the primary measures of success, alongside traditional SLAs. Ensure ticketing, request, and knowledge processes are simple, consistent, and easy for employees to navigate regardless of how they choose to engage (portal, chat, phone, walk-up). Own GRC, vendor risk management (VRM), and policy exception workflows on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely processing and audit-ready records. Own portal and content management for the ServiceNow platform, ensuring employees can easily find and act on the right services and policies. Employee Lifecycle Technology (Onboarding & Offboarding)

Own the technology experience for onboarding, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring new hires are productive on day one and departures are secure and frictionless. Modernize onboarding/offboarding into an automated, orchestrated workflow spanning identity, access provisioning, equipment, and collaboration tools — eliminating manual handoffs across HR, IT, and Security. Partner with HR, Security, and Facilities to design a seamless, employee-centric lifecycle journey, with clear accountability for every step and status transparent to the employee and their manager. Continuously reduce time-to-productivity for new hires and time-to-deprovision for departures, tracking both as core experience and risk metrics. Digital Workplace Engineering & Endpoint Experience

Own engineering and lifecycle management for employee-facing technology: endpoints, mobility, unified endpoint management (UEM), collaboration tools, and meeting room/AV technology. Drive modernization of the digital workplace — proactive device health monitoring, zero-touch provisioning, self-healing endpoints, and simplified software deployment — to minimize disruption to employees. Ensure collaboration and meeting technologies (video, conferencing, messaging) provide a consistently excellent experience across office, lab, and hybrid work settings. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security to ensure digital workplace standards remain secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise architecture principles. M365 & Collaboration Platform Delivery

Own service delivery for the M365 platform — Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive, and Power Automate — including platform guardrails, governance, and adoption. Own voice and unified communications service delivery, ensuring reliable, modern calling and conferencing capability across the enterprise. Drive continuous improvement of collaboration tooling to reduce friction and support hybrid and global ways of working. Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform roadmap decisions and with Security on data governance within M365 workloads. Field & Deskside Support Operations

Own field and deskside support across all Regeneron sites, ensuring consistent, high-quality in-person support where self-service and remote resolution aren't sufficient. Right-size the deskside support model as digital self-service and remote resolution capabilities mature, reallocating capacity toward higher-value, in-person needs (labs, executive support, events). Ensure support models scale appropriately across site types (corporate, R&D/lab, manufacturing) with services tailored to how each site's population actually works. Own end-to-end lifecycle management of end-user assets — procurement coordination, deployment, tracking, refresh cycles, and secure disposal/decommissioning. Maintain accurate asset inventory and compliance reporting to support audit, cost management, and security requirements. Experience Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Establish a consistent employee experience measurement framework (CSAT, NPS, effort scores) across every touchpoint in this tower, replacing purely operational SLA reporting. Run a continuous improvement cadence — mining ticket, sentiment, and usage data to identify friction points and prioritize fixes before they become recurring complaints. Report employee technology experience trends and improvement outcomes to executive stakeholders, connecting operational data to business and workforce impact. Vendor & Platform Management

Own vendor relationships and contracts for service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and digital workplace tooling, ensuring value, performance, and roadmap alignment. Establish a vendor governance cadence — performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, and value/ROI tracking — holding vendors accountable to continuous improvement commitments rather than static contract terms. Partner with Finance and Procurement to manage the cost-to-serve for employee technology, balancing experience improvements against operating budget discipline. Evaluate emerging digital workplace and AI-enabled support technologies, building the business case for adoption where they meaningfully improve employee experience or reduce cost-to-serve. People Leadership, Mentoring & Team Culture

Determine the organizational structure and operational direction for the function, directing critical work through subordinate managers and senior leaders. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed organization across service desk, lifecycle technology, digital workplace engineering, and field support. Mentor and coach people leaders across the organization, investing in career growth, succession planning, and bench strength. Model and reinforce a customer-obsessed, continuous-improvement culture, holding the team accountable to employee experience outcomes, not just ticket throughput. Champion development and team culture within the function, fostering collaboration across a global, follow-the-sun operating model. Key Working Relationships

This role is viewed across Regeneron as a role model for employee-centric technology delivery and is regularly sought out by leaders at all levels for advice on employee technology matters. Because much of this role's influence runs through governance and partnership rather than direct authority over every function it touches, it also serves as the principal spokesperson for employee technology and digital workplace matters on highly significant issues, and is expected to negotiate difficult matters with senior management and functional heads, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field is required. A master's degree or MBA is preferred. 17+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, end-user computing, digital workplace, or IT operations leadership roles. Deep expertise in ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks, and hands-on experience modernizing an ITSM platform (ServiceNow strongly preferred). Proven experience redesigning employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding) into an automated, cross-functional workflow spanning IT, HR, and Security. Strong grounding in digital workplace and end-user computing technologies — unified endpoint management, collaboration platforms, mobility, and AV/conferencing. Track record of building and using experience metrics (CSAT, NPS, deflection rate, first-contact resolution) to drive continuous improvement, not just SLA compliance. Experience leveraging automation, self-service, and AI/virtual agent technologies to reduce support volume and improve employee experience. Proven ability to build, scale, and lead large, globally distributed service organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent across a follow-the-sun model. Experience operating in a matrixed, governance-driven environment — partnering with peers in Enterprise Architecture and IT Strategy & Transformation without direct authority over their teams. Strong vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating and managing platform and outsourced support relationships, with a track record of driving ongoing vendor performance and value through structured governance (scorecards, business reviews). Sound business and financial acumen, with experience managing cost-to-serve and building business cases for employee technology investment. jobs.title: Analista en protección a Endpoint y XDR
jobs.summary: Desde una consultoría líder europea en servicios y soluciones digitales buscamos un/a Especialista en Protección de Endpoint y XDR para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad, dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal deberá...
jobs.description:
Desde una consultoría líder europea en servicios y soluciones digitales buscamos un/a Especialista en Protección de Endpoint y XDR para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad, dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal deberá contar con una sólida comprensión de las tecnologías de protección de Endpoint (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), así como de plataformas EDR, XDR y SIEM, orientando su actividad al análisis, la investigación y la respuesta ante amenazas de seguridad.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia en la administración, explotación y optimización de estas tecnologías, capaz de interpretar eventos de seguridad, identificar patrones de comportamiento malicioso y contribuir a la mejora continua de las capacidades de detección y respuesta. Se valorarán conocimientos sobre despliegue e implantación de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, aunque estas funciones no constituirán el foco principal del puesto.

Esta posición representa una excelente oportunidad para profesionales apasionados por la ciberseguridad que deseen contribuir activamente a la protección de organizaciones de alto nivel.

Responsabilidades:

* Analizar eventos, alertas y registros de seguridad procedentes de plataformas Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM para identificar amenazas potenciales y actividades sospechosas.
* Investigar incidentes de ciberseguridad, participando en las actividades de detección, análisis, contención y seguimiento hasta su resolución.
* Administrar y optimizar las capacidades de monitorización, detección y respuesta de las soluciones Endpoint y XDR.
* Colaborar en la definición y mejora de casos de uso, reglas de detección, procedimientos operativos y playbooks de respuesta.
* Realizar análisis de amenazas, indicadores de compromiso (IoC) y tendencias emergentes para fortalecer la postura de seguridad.
* Colaborar con otros equipos de seguridad y operaciones para mejorar la capacidad de prevención, detección y respuesta ante incidentes.
* Participar en la integración y puesta en marcha de nuevas capacidades de protección Endpoint y XDR, aportando conocimientos funcionales y operativos.
* Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas amenazas, vulnerabilidades, técnicas de ataque y tendencias del sector de la ciberseguridad.

Requisitos:

* Titulación en Informática, Ciberseguridad o áreas afines. Se valorará experiencia equivalente.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con foco en tecnologías Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM.
* Experiencia en administración, monitorización y análisis de soluciones de protección Endpoint y XDR.
* Conocimientos en análisis de logs, correlación de eventos, detección de amenazas y Threat Hunting.
* Experiencia en gestión e investigación de incidentes de ciberseguridad.
* Conocimiento de procesos de respuesta ante incidentes, casos de uso y buenas prácticas de operaciones de seguridad.
* Conocimientos de integración y despliegue de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, valorándose experiencia en proyectos de implantación.
* Capacidad analítica, orientación a la resolución de problemas y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
* Certificaciones de seguridad como Security+ (deseable ), CySA+, SC-200, SC-100, CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator/Analyst, CEH, GSEC o CISSP.

*Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto.*

*Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.*

*Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.*

*Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.*

*El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.*

*Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.*

jobs.description:
Gracia101 is looking for an **MDM Consultant**on behalf of a global organization based in Barcelona.

This role is responsible for designing and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) processes within their area, ensuring these processes meet business needs while promoting consistency across the organization. The role holder will ensure MDM processes remain aligned with company policies and the broader operating model, and will act as the key point of contact with IT and MDM Technical Solutions teams to implement and support MDM solutions.

Key accountabilities:

* Design Master Data Management processes in own area. Ensure processes are compliant to group Policies and DoAs. Ensure MDM processes fulfil the needs of --and are validated by --process stakeholders,
* Ensure all owned processes are documented according to standards. Support audits (ISO certifications, customer audits..),
* Support M\&A and IT projects (such as ERP implementation) by defining adequate Master Data setup and processes,
* May lead work packages for solution implementation projects (including running design workshops)
* Interface with MDM Technical Solutions to implement technical solutions in Informatica,
* Interface with IT to implement technical solutions in backend SAP systems.
* Engage with MDM Services for implementation of process or solution changes.
* Define cleansing rules with data owners for ensuring owned data readiness for transformation projects
* Provide third level support to MDM Services teams (what to do if not in the books)
* Follow-up on MDM continuous improvement initiatives in own area.
* Ensure continuous dialogue with process stakeholders and MDM Services teams to nourish continuous improvement process.
* Keep documentation and data assets (data catalog) up-to-date for own area

Education \& Experience:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering or Business administration or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Master Data Management
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Experience in a multinational company / exposure to diverse cultures

Critical competencies:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor
* Strong SAP expertise, in particular regardingmaster data objects in own area
* Proficient in process modeling and design
* Good communication and presentation skills.

**If you are ready to help shape the future of global master data and bring together business processes, SAP and MDM technology, we would love to hear from you.**

jobs.description:
**The Basics**

We are seeking a highly skilled IT Infrastructure Engineer with expertise in Systems Administration to join the IT Engineering team at Tanium. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and managing our hybrid systems infrastructure to ensure the availability, security, and maintenance of our systems.

**_This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; or Emeryville, CA._**

**What you'll do**

- Embrace Tanium’s mission and core values.
- Act as member of IT Infrastructure Engineering team with a focus on systems management and project delivery
- Perform infrastructure deployment, management, planning, scaling, scheduling, etc.
- Drive and enhance automation wherever possible in the name of efficiency, scalability, and consistency
- Work with a variety of key business groups to architect and implement technology and solutions
- Be accountable for ensuring all technology is documented, deployed and configured securely and in alignment with best practices
- Leverage AI and automation tools extensively for daily tasks, integrations and operationand management of IT and business services
- Follow the change management process for system configuration, installations, and maintenance
- Collaborate with other technical teams to resolve operational challenges and streamline workflows
- Participate in projects related to iInfrastructure, business execution, security, etc
- Solve incidents and administrative tasks related to infrastructure services and other escalations from end-user support.
- Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
- Effectively communicate technical concepts and solutions to non-technical stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and productive working environment.
- Participate in on-call rotations
- Be a team player who is adaptive, self-motivated, and solution-oriented

**We’re looking for someone with**

4+ years as a Systems Administrator, Operations Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer or similar, with relevant enterprise experiencein the following areas:

- Strong background with Linux, Windows andVMware(or similar) systems administration and deployment.
- Direct administration experience with Cloud Computing & Networking Environments. Azure (preferred), AWS, and GCP.
- Experience with Bash, Python and PowerShell scripting
- Experience with TCP/IP networking and troubleshooting.
- Experience with backups, high availability and overall infrastructure resiliency for cloud and on-premises technology required
- Familiarity with monitoring and management of enterprise systems running on physical and cloud infrastructure required
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code toolsets – e.g. Terraform, Vault.
- Experience with Configuration Management toolsets - Ansible (Preferred).
- Experience with SAN storage arrays and troubleshooting.
- Ability to estimate and manage cloud usage costs and identify and operationalize cost control mechanisms preferred
- Familiarity with CI tools - GitHub Actions (preferred)
- Familiarity with Docker and other container technologies (Kubernetes, Amazon ECS/EKS)
- Demonstrated ability to work with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, GRC, Product Engineering and other teams to drive architectural decisions for cloud and on-premises technologies

**About Tanium**

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit [www.tanium.com](http://www.tanium.com/) and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tanium) and [X](https://twitter.com/Tanium).

**On a mission. Together.**

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

**What you’ll get**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $113,000 to $173,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact [accommodations@tanium.com](mailto:accommodations@tanium.com). For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - [https://www.eeoc.gov/poster](https://www.eeoc.gov/poster).

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

The machine-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.

For more information on how Tanium processes your personal data, please see our [Privacy Policy](https://www.tanium.com/privacy-policy/).

This role provides advanced technical expertise for diagnosing and resolving complex endpoint issues, leading provisioning and lifecycle activities during high demand periods. It analyzes performance trends to drive workflow improvements, develops technical documentation, and collaborates with engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to define and uphold endpoint standards. The Endpoint Engineer position applies independent judgment to select methods and tools that enhance reliability and service quality.

Responsibilities

Serve as a subject-matter expert for advanced troubleshooting, diagnostic analysis, and remediation of endpoint and business application issues, leveraging deep technical expertise to resolve escalations and prevent recurrence. Provide advanced-tier technical support and troubleshooting for Windows and macOS endpoints, including operating systems, applications, endpoint agents, clients, services, connectivity, and configuration issues. Perform weekly Windows patching activities, including monitoring patch deployments, creating associated change requests, validating patch results, and performing light troubleshooting when patches fail. Perform endpoint remediation activities in coordination with Endpoint Engineering, including troubleshooting failed automations, scripts, software deployments, and endpoint configurations, and supporting the testing, validation, and production deployment of endpoint solutions. Support endpoint provisioning, configuration management, upgrade planning, and lifecycle optimization during surge periods or complex engagements, ensuring alignment with engineering standards. Support vulnerability management activities by reviewing vulnerability dashboards and reports, researching affected endpoints, executing established remediation scripts and processes, developing or modifying remediation scripts, deploying approved remediation, and managing associated tickets and change requests. Perform manual remediation of individual endpoints with multiple vulnerabilities, failed agents or clients, corrupted applications, or other conditions requiring hands-on troubleshooting. Monitor endpoint health and compliance dashboards and reports, identify endpoints that fall out of compliance, and perform appropriate remediation to restore endpoint health and compliance. Evaluate trends in endpoint performance, incident patterns, and operational workflows to recommend and implement improvements that enhance efficiency and support a shift-left strategy. Participate in the development, testing, and production deployment of solutions for special-purpose machine configurations and project-based endpoint deployments in collaboration with Endpoint Engineering. Analyze Windows Event Viewer, macOS Console, application logs, and endpoint management-agent logs to diagnose issues and support remediation. Develop documentation, technical runbooks, and knowledge base articles to enable operational excellence and support continuous improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to support and uphold endpoint standards and ensure adoption of best practices. Exercise independent judgment in selecting methods, tools, and techniques to address technical challenges and improve endpoint reliability.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s preferred or equivalent experience. Minimum of 8 years related endpoint engineering or technical support experience. US Citizenship is required

The standard work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

To support operational demands and customer requirements, occasional evening, after-hours, and weekend work may be required.

Required Skills:

Strong Windows and macOS expertise. Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and/or Jamf. Working knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, or other shell scripting sufficient to execute, troubleshoot, and modify endpoint automation and remediation scripts. Strong customer service and technical communication skills

Prefereed Skills:

ADDITIONAL / PLUS EXPERIENCE: Windows/macOS hardening, deeper vulnerability management framework experience, advanced automation/ scripting experience.

Additional benefits include:

Competitive salary: $80,000 - $85,000 Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Disability, Life Insurance, and AD&D Flexible Spending Accounts 401K with employer matching contribution Tuition and Education Reimbursement Exercise Reimbursement Tech Reimbursement Employee Assistance Program Opportunities for professional development and growth Collaborative and dynamic work environment

You will administer and support Azure Government and Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High services, helping ensure reliable, secure, and compliant cloud operations.You will manage Microsoft Entra ID identity and access services, including authentication, authorization, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.You will support cloud networking and application delivery services, including Azure Firewall, Azure Domain Name System (DNS), Azure Front Door, and Web Application Firewall technologies.You will investigate and respond to security events using Microsoft Defender technologies, perform vulnerability remediation, and support incident response activities.You will troubleshoot complex production issues, automate operational tasks using PowerShell and Azure Playbooks, and contribute to continuous improvement of service reliability and security.

Description and Requirements

The Senior Manager, NA Service Management Office (SMO) is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing customer programs and service delivery governance for Digital Workplace Solutions across North America. This role ensures consistent, high-quality service management execution across a diverse customer portfolio, driving operational excellence, financial discipline, customer satisfaction, and team engagement.

The customer-facing role serves as a strategic interface between customers, delivery teams, and executive leadership, ensuring commitments are met, risks are mitigated, and service outcomes align with contractual, financial, and experience expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Program Leadership

Lead the North America Service Management Office overseeing multiple, complex Digital Workplace Solutions customer programs.
Act as an executive-level escalation point for service delivery, contractual, financial, and customer satisfaction issues.
Ensure consistent service management standards, governance, and reporting across all customer accounts.
Partner with account leadership to drive customer outcomes, renewals, and long-term relationship health.

Service Management & Governance

Own and enforce SMO frameworks within the geo including service delivery governance, operational cadence, KPI tracking, and performance reviews.
Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned service management practices, SLAs, OLAs, and contractual commitments.
Drive root cause analysis, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives across customer programs.
Maintain visibility into delivery risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, proactively addressing issues before escalation.

Service Innovation & Automation

Advance DWS through the adoption of AI-enabled and automation-driven service management capabilities, aligned to organizational priorities and customer needs.
Partner with IT to identify, pilot, and scale AI and automation use cases.
Drive standardization and modernization of service operations by reducing manual effort, improving responsiveness, and increasing service accuracy through intelligent tooling and automation.
Ensure AI and automation initiatives are embedded into SMO governance models, operational cadence, and performance metrics.
Promote responsible and scalable adoption of AI by ensuring alignment to security, compliance, ethical standards, and enterprise architecture guidelines.

Financial & Operational Management

Partner with finance and delivery leadership to manage cost, margin, and productivity targets across customer programs.
Ensure effective demand management, capacity planning, and resource optimization across NA DWS engagements.
Support pricing, forecasting, and change management activities tied to customer contracts and scope changes.

People & Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop team manager, service delivery managers and coordinators within the SMO.
Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Drive employee engagement, retention, and succession planning within the organization.
Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned to service and business outcomes.

Executive & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, IT, HR, Finance, and Global SMO leadership.
Provide executive-level reporting and insights on customer health, performance trends, and risk areas.
Support transformation and standardization initiatives across Digital Workplace Solutions.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or related field.
10+ years of experience in IT service delivery, service management, or managed services environments.
5+ years in people leadership roles managing service management resources.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Strong experience leading large-scale, customer-facing programs in Digital Workplace or End-User Computing services.
Demonstrated experience managing P&L, cost controls, and operational metrics.
ITIL certification or strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks.
Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed, global organizations.
Proven ability to manage executive-level customer relationships and high-impact escalations.
Strong analytical, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Track record of driving service improvements while balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Design Nurse Call, RTLS, Wander Management, patient information and entertainment displays, Public Address, clock, and other critical communication and life safety systems.

Associate’s degree in Electrical Technology, or vocational/military electronics training, or equivalent relevant work experience.
Minimum of 3 years of related work experience in the deployment, installation, engineering, or design of low-voltage systems.
Working knowledge of AutoCAD for creating and editing technical drawings.
Rauland, Centrak, Midmark, Biamp, or similar product experience is desirable but not required.
Ability to read and interpret construction plans and specifications.
Basic math computation skills to include addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages and fractions.

Professional self-starter who is reliable, flexible, proactive, resilient, organized, and punctual.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively express ideas and information.
Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment.
A high level of commitment to customer satisfaction.

Ability to maintain industry-recognized technology credentials.

Long Tenured: Not to brag, but our team rocks! With an average employee tenure of 11 years, our experience authenticates our capabilities. Nuestro Centro de Soporte tiene establecida una gestión del talento enfocada en potenciar el bienestar y el rendimiento del equipo.

Modelo híbrido - País Vasco

**¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?** Tus funciones principales serán:

* Gestionar y resolver incidencias y peticiones de segundo nivel sobre entornos Linux e infraestructuras críticas, garantizando la continuidad del servicio.
* Analizar, diagnosticar e implementar soluciones técnicas, aplicando las correcciones necesarias a través de las herramientas y procedimientos definidos en el proyecto.
* Colaborar con diferentes equipos técnicos en la resolución de incidencias complejas, problemas recurrentes y situaciones de alta criticidad.
* Realizar tareas de administración, mantenimiento y mejora continua de las plataformas, asegurando su estabilidad, rendimiento y disponibilidad.
* Monitorizar el estado de los sistemas, identificando de forma proactiva posibles riesgos o incidencias antes de que impacten en el servicio.
* Participar en el análisis, seguimiento y escalado de incidencias, contribuyendo a la optimización de procesos y a la evolución de la infraestructura.

**¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?**

* Ciclo formativo de grado superior en Administración de Sistemas Informáticos.
* Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en soporte técnico de segundo nivel.
* Experiencia demostrable en entornos GNU/Linux, herramientas UEM y gestión centralizada de dispositivos.
* Capacidad de resolución de incidencias, peticiones y cambios en entornos corporativos
* Idiomas:

* Euskera nivel C1

* Inglés nivel B2

****¿QUE ENCONTRARÁS EN SEIDOR?****

* Un equipo diverso. Respetamos las diferencias que nos hacen más humanos. 💜
* Compañerismo. Trabajamos en equipo y aprendemos los unos de los otros.
* Flexibilidad y conciliación. El teletrabajo está en nuestro ADN. Promovemos la flexibilidad horaria, y tenemos jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de julio y agosto. 🙌
* Aprendizaje continuo. Formaciones en idiomas, técnicas, certificaciones, etc.
* Carrera profesional individualizada, para que seas tú quien decide hasta dónde quieres llegar. 🚀
* Autonomía y posibilidad de proponer y promover nuevas oportunidades.
* Programa de retribución flexible. Tickets guardería, restaurante, transporte, y seguro médico.
* Descuentos exclusivos y condiciones especiales en tecnología, ocio, viajes, etc. 🌟
* Podrás formar parte de iniciativas solidarias y relacionadas con el medio ambiente.
* Si tienes inquietudes internacionales, estamos en 45 países. 🌍

**¡Únete a nuestro equipo y ayúdanos a humanizar el mundo a través de la tecnología!**

jobs.summary: The Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **end-to-end management and support of endpoint management platforms** , primarily **Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM)** and **Microsoft Intune (MEM)**. This role covers **device lifecycle management,...
jobs.description:
The Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **end-to-end management and support of endpoint management platforms** , primarily **Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM)** and **Microsoft Intune (MEM)**.

This role covers **device lifecycle management, patching, application packaging \& deployment, policy enforcement, and troubleshooting** . The engineer is expected to **resolve complex endpoint issues, ensure compliance, and maintain platform health** across enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Platform Support (SCCM \& Intune)**

* Administer and support:
* SCCM (ConfigMgr) infrastructure
* Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM)
* Co-management (SCCM Intune integration)
* Monitor platform health (site servers, distribution points, connectors, sync status)
* Troubleshoot client-side and server-side issues

**Patch Management (Critical Responsibility)**

* Plan, deploy, and monitor **monthly patching cycles** (Windows updates via SCCM/Intune)
* Ensure compliance with defined SLAs and patch baselines
* Troubleshoot patch failures and deployment issues
* Generate patch compliance and audit reports
* Coordinate with application and business teams for patch validation

**Application Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package applications using:
* MSI / EXE / Intune Win32 formats
* Deploy applications via SCCM and Intune
* Handle:
* Application testing and validation
* Version upgrades and rollback strategies
* Troubleshoot deployment failures and detection logic issues

**Device Management \& Policy Enforcement**

* Manage device configurations using:
* Group Policy (GPO)
* Intune configuration profiles
* Compliance policies and conditional access
* Enroll and manage devices (Windows, mobile devices if applicable)
* Ensure endpoint compliance with security standards

**Incident \& Problem Management**

* Act as **L2 resolver group** for endpoint-related incidents
* Troubleshoot issues such as:
* Software deployment failures
* Patch compliance gaps
* Device enrollment issues
* Policy conflicts (GPO vs Intune)
* Identify recurring issues and support Problem Management

**Automation \& Optimization**

* Use PowerShell for:
* Automation of deployment tasks
* Reporting and remediation scripts
* Improve deployment efficiency and reduce manual effort
* Optimize collections, deployments, and update rings

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 What you'll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Enterprise Support Engineer (ESE) serves as a primary escalation point for customers experiencing advanced technical issues, in addition to acting as an initial point of entry for customers and partners that have elected Premium Support or are strategically valuable to Jamf. The ESE demonstrates proficiency in concepts and practices involving device management and security. The ESE works closely with the Technical Account Manager. The ESE is responsible for supporting and troubleshooting issues with the installation, performance, and integration of Jamf products and supporting technologies. The ESE serves as a point of contact for all technical inquiries and escalations.

    This is a hybrid position available to individuals residing in the Minneapolis, MN metro area. You will be expected to be in the office 3 days per week. Please note that we are only able to consider applicants who are currently based in the Minneapolis, MN metro area.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Serve as the primary point of contact for Premium Support customers experiencing technical issues.

- Handle customer inquiries related to product performance, configurations, custom setups, and integrations.

- Diagnose and resolve issues across the full suite of RapidIdentity products.

- Use logs, debugging tools, and root cause analysis to efficiently solve technical problems.

- Act as a customer advocate and account steward, demonstrate relentless commitment to developing effective solutions to the challenges that customers face in optimizing their deployment.

- Work closely with product development and engineering teams to identify and resolve bugs and provide feedback on product improvements.

- Interface with product development and support teams to share client feedback, generate requirements and evaluate and test new product solutions

- Maintain and increase customer satisfaction and ensure retention

- Keep customers informed about the status of their issues and provide regular updates on progress.

- Serve as a topic expert in one or more key product features

- Contribute to internal and external knowledge bases through the creation and continual review of knowledge base and troubleshooting guides.

- Provide support for customers using APIs and third-party integrations, assisting with implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting.

- Collaborate with customers’ internal teams/stakeholders to address challenges.

- Build strong relationships with enterprise customers, acting as their advocate within the company.

- Identify patterns in support cases and provide insights to improve the product or internal processes.

- Stay current on new product features, technologies, and industry trends to provide the best possible support.

- On-Call as needed.

- Other duties as assigned.

- #LI-Hybrid

 What we are looking for:

- Minimum 3 years in a customer support or technical support role, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment (Required)

- Must demonstrate the ability to read code, troubleshoot logic issues, and make necessary adjustments to correct functionality or implement customer requested changes (Required)

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical details into clear, customer-friendly language.

- Strong technical troubleshooting skills, with knowledge of log analysis, debugging, and system diagnostics

- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Experience with APIs, web technologies, networking and databases (e.g., SQL).

- Working knowledge of the architecture and tools relevant to implementation of Jamf products.

- Strong problem-solving abilities with a customer-first mentality.

- Advanced technical knowledge and an aptitude for learning new software systems.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Empathetic and patient in dealing with customer issues.

- Highly organized, with attention to detail and accuracy.

- Self-motivated with a proactive approach to resolving customer issues.

- A team player who can collaborate effectively across departments and with both technical and non-technical teams.

- Skilled with CRM and support tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Intercom, or similar).

- Leads peers and others through change; champions change in the face of uncertainty.

- Actively seek opportunities for self-improvement, staying current with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices.

- Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure or critical situations.

- Be able to identify not just the symptoms of a problem but understand and address the underlying cause to prevent recurring issues.

- A meticulous approach to troubleshooting, ensuring all details are considered, from error logs to system behavior, to avoid overlooking critical factors with an emphasis on finding solutions to business needs.

- Ability to critical analyze issues and use sound judgement to make decisions

- Provide clear written summaries and technical documentation for internal teams and customers, maintaining professionalism and accuracy in communication.

- Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred)

- Jamf 400 (Preferred)

- Jamf 370 (Preferred)

 SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

 How we help you reach your best potential:

- Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News

- Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

- Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®

- We train and we then we give you the room to grow. We offer a clear and defined customer support career path, but our Jamfs also choose to explore horizontal career growth to discover new interests and opportunities.

- Our Support teams are the technical experts solving problems big and small for our loyal customer base. Tech support is human support and you will know you are making a real and meaningful impact for our more than 75,000 global customer base.

- Our customers are some of the most loyal in the world. We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us!

 Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

 $64,800 - $117,480 USD

 We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

 What does Jamf do?
 Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

jobs.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an MDM (Reltio) Solution Engineer to join our ever-evolving Data & AI team and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you will build the trusted data foundation that powers critical business decisions across Global Payments, enabling accurate customer and merchant insights, stronger risk and compliance outcomes, and more effective business operations. You will play a key role in creating scalable Master Data Management capabilities that establish a single source of truth across the enterprise, driving innovation, improving data quality, and helping teams make faster, smarter decisions. As part of a highly collaborative and forward-thinking team, you will influence enterprise-wide data strategy, support modernization efforts, and contribute directly to Global Payments’ mission of delivering exceptional solutions that power commerce around the world.

What you'll own

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In April 2022, we introduced a new, more affordable, ad-supported tier for our customers, marking a significant milestone for Netflix. Our focus is now on expanding choices for consumers and providing advertisers with a premium TV brand experience that surpasses traditional linear formats. The challenge ahead involves scaling our ad tech to maximize its impact on our business.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

The Ads Member Experience group is responsible for identifying and building the ad formats that will define the future of advertising on the Netflix streaming platform, including live events. The team will drive the definition of such formats and how they are standardized across delivery platforms (TV, mobile, web). It will lead the experimentation needed to make the experience optimal for both users and advertisers.

Our team is new and yet faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

This role is part of the company's strategic initiative to build a world-class advertising ecosystem following the launch of their ad-supported tier. We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

* 8+ years of software development experience, with 5+ years of experience in the Ads domain

* Professional experience with ad formats and ad delivery systems, including experimentation with ad creatives and/or native ads.

* Experience with architecting and building large-scale infrastructure for real-time, low-latency, online advertising environments.

* Thorough understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape, with a focus on publisher side challenges like optimizing fill rates, adjusting ad load, and maximizing advertiser value.

* Proven track record of building systems that power sophisticated user experimentation, A/B testing and lift studies.

* Strong analytical and strategic thinking with demonstrated product sense and leadership in the working environment.

* Expertise in developing systems that measure and optimize end-user advertising experiences, delivering the right advertisement at the right time for the right user.

* Track record of collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders from product, engineering, design, etc. and of delivering complex features with critical business impact

Nice to haves:

* Familiarity with SDUI (Server-Driven User Interface) architectures.

* Experience building unique ad formats and ad products at scale across multiple advertising channels (CTV, DOOH, Mobile, and Web).

* Programmatic advertisement experience.

* Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g. VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

* Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar’s Cybersecurity Team is seeking a Security Analyst to join our Caterpillar IT Cybersecurity Team. In this role you will have the opportunity to deploy, manage and support products and tools that protect Caterpillar resources from cybersecurity threats. As a member of this team, you will assist with discovering, assessing, and addressing new security challenges facing the organization. Ideal candidates would be highly motivated and technically proficient, as well as capable of participating on a team to complete tasks, assignments, and projects in both individual and cooperative group-based contexts.

What You Will Do:

Support Caterpillar’s Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) (including Linux/Ubuntu server), Identity Management, Vulnerability Management / Attack Surface Visibility / Response Actions environments.

Promote automation for monitoring and remediation of client health issues, monitoring of EDR Infrastructure, vulnerability remediation, and aligning to Enterprise ITSM change and control procedures.

Be a liaison between Corporate Cybersecurity, and our business partners to help understand their operations and maintain global security processes, while building collaborative relationships, provides expertise, technical guidance, and security awareness as needed.

Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and SOC teams to implement detection logic and improve threat visibility.

Contribute to the development of automated detection and response capabilities.

Be a part of continuous vulnerability lifecycle management within the Caterpillar environment including the collection, reporting and assessment of impact for vulnerability related data from external and internal sources.

Serve as liaison between Corporate Cybersecurity and our business partners to help understand their operations and maintain global security processes, while building collaborative relationships.

What You Have:

Cybersecurity Standards and Policies:

Knowledge of developing cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures; ability to develop and communicate policies, standards and procedures that guide interactions with customers.

Endpoint Security:
• Knowledge of the tools and processes for maintaining endpoint security; ability to design and implement security programs to prevent data loss and access intrusion from external sources.
Strong experience in Enterprise Tool Support (AV, EDR, Vulnerability Scanner, SCCM, etc)
• Familiarity with infrastructure and services used to support secure, scalable applications, whether on-premises or in hybrid/cloud environments.

Information Security Technologies:
• Knowledge of technologies and technology-based solutions dealing with information security issues; ability to protect information security across the organization using encryption technologies and appropriate security software.

Information Technology (IT) Security Policies:
• Knowledge of IT security policies, standards, and procedures; ability to utilize a variety of administrative skill sets and technical knowledge to ensure cyber security compliance.
• Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.
• Knowledge of developing cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures; ability to develop and communicate policies, standards and procedures that guide interactions with customers.

Requirements Analysis:
• Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

System and Technology Integration:

• Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases, and technology platforms.
• Experience with Host Group, Prevention Sensor, and Policy Configuration
• Exposure to SQL, PowerShell or Python Scripting, Command Line Interfaces
• OS Administration: Linux, Windows, MacOS (command line, services, data manipulation, installation, and system operation)
• Experience with Windows/MacOS Frameworks
• Experience in MacOS security and compliance management, including continuous monitoring and automated remediation for endpoints
• Remote Administration Tools
• Installing/Removing/troubleshooting MSI packages

Technical Writing/Documentation:
• Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes, and applications.
• Experience in maintaining system documentation in an enterprise tool (i.e. SharePoint, OneNote, etc) for group dissemination.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions and present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, plain language appropriate to the audience.

Cyber Security:
• Knowledge of antivirus/malware attacks and the defenses used; ability to defend and prevent electronic threats, theft, and attacks.
• Relevant cybersecurity certifications or training in Endpoint Detection and Response.
• Experience in utilizing various commercial vulnerability notification tools to analyze vulnerabilities and devise solutions for remediation.

Education / Experience: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

For more than a century, Caterpillar has helped build a better, more sustainable world. With 2025 sales and revenues of $67.6 billion, Caterpillar Inc. is shaping the future as the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a mid-level Project Manager to support the planning and execution of large-scale customer technology migrations, with a primary focus on network infrastructure and endpoint migrations. This role will coordinate cross-functional teams, customers, vendors, and technical stakeholders to ensure migrations are delivered safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to business operations. The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive project leader who can manage multiple concurrent migration workstreams, drive accountability across technical teams, communicate effectively with customers and executives, and identify and resolve risks before they impact delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project planning and execution for large-scale customer network and endpoint migration initiatives.

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, and cutover plans.

Coordinate migration activities across network engineering, endpoint engineering, security, infrastructure, service delivery, operations, vendors, and customer teams.

Manage multiple concurrent migration projects and prioritize activities based on customer impact, technical dependencies, and business timelines.

Facilitate project kickoffs, status meetings, technical working sessions, migration readiness reviews, and executive updates.

Establish clear ownership, deadlines, and escalation paths across internal and external stakeholders.

Track project scope, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource requirements through completion.

Coordinate migration waves, pilot deployments, production cutovers, validation activities, and post-migration stabilization.

Partner with technical teams to ensure migration prerequisites, testing, documentation, rollback plans, and operational readiness are completed before cutover.

Proactively identify project risks and develop mitigation and contingency plans.

Manage customer communications and provide clear, concise status reporting on progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.

Support change management and ensure project activities align with established change-control and operational processes.

Drive post-migration lessons learned and incorporate improvements into subsequent migration waves.

Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure appropriate handoffs to operational support teams.

Required Qualifications

Requires a BA degree and 8 – 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 – 10 years of prior relevant experience.

Active DoD Secret clearance

3–6 years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting technology infrastructure or IT transformation initiatives.

Experience managing large-scale infrastructure, network, endpoint, cloud, data center, or technology migration projects.

Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex projects involving multiple technical teams and stakeholders.

Strong understanding of project management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risk management, change control, and stakeholder management.

Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders in a delivery environment.

Strong communication, organization, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working with technical teams and translating technical project information into clear business-level communications.

Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Confluence, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification.

Experience with network migrations, LAN/WAN transformations, SD-WAN, network modernization, endpoint refreshes, device migrations, or enterprise infrastructure consolidation.

Experience managing large customer migration programs involving multiple sites, business units, or geographic regions.

Familiarity with ITIL, Agile, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

Experience coordinating third-party vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners.

Experience with migration planning, cutover management, rollback planning, and hypercare/stabilization.

Technical background or sufficient technical fluency to effectively partner with network, endpoint, infrastructure, and security engineering teams.

jobs.description:
**Descripción de la empresa** *Inetum es líder europeo en servicios digitales. El equipo de Inetum, formado por 28.000 consultores y especialistas, se esfuerza cada día por generar un impacto digital en las empresas, las entidades del sector público y la sociedad. Las soluciones de Inetum tienen como objetivo contribuir al desempeño y la innovación de sus clientes, así como al bien común.* *Presente en 19 países con una densa red de sitios, Inetum se asocia con los principales editores de software para afrontar los desafíos de la transformación digital con proximidad y flexibilidad.* *Impulsado por su ambición de crecimiento y escala, Inetum generó unas ventas de 2.400 millones de euros en 2024.* *🏅 Top Employer Europe 2025* *🏅 Top Employer Spain 2025* **Descripción del empleo** Únete a **Inetum** para participar en la transformación tecnológica y digital de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales. Estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto positivo en nuestros clientes, sus procesos y tecnología, pero también en ti.

Por ello, buscamos **un/a Especialista en protección a Endpoint y XDR** para unirse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal tendrá que tener una amplia comprensión de las tecnologías de seguridad de protección a **Endpoint** (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), **XDR, EDR y SIEM** , así como experiencia en la implementación, administración y optimización de soluciones del tipo Endpoint y XDR. Este puesto es una excelente oportunidad para un/a profesional apasionado/a por la ciberseguridad que busque contribuir a la protección de una organización de alto perfil.

**Responsabilidades**

* Implementar, administrar y optimizar soluciones de protección a Endpoint y XDR de última generación en entornos complejos.
* Integrar herramientas de protección a Endpoint y XDR con otras herramientas de seguridad para obtener una visión holística del panorama de amenazas.
* Analizar logs y eventos de seguridad para identificar y responder a amenazas potenciales de manera oportuna.
* Desarrollar y mantener playbooks de respuesta a incidentes automatizados para garantizar una respuesta rápida y efectiva a los incidentes de seguridad.
* Gestionar incidentes de ciberseguridad desde su detección hasta su resolución, utilizando herramientas y procesos de protección a Endpoint y XDR.
* Colaborar con otros equipos de seguridad para mejorar la postura de seguridad general de la organización.
* Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas amenazas, vulnerabilidades y tendencias en ciberseguridad.

**Requisitos**

* Ingeniería en Informática, Ciberseguridad o área relacionada.
* Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con enfoque en Endpoint (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), XDR, EDR y SIEM.
* Experiencia en la implementación, administración y optimización de soluciones de protección a Endpoint y XDR.
* Sólidos conocimientos de log management, análisis de eventos de seguridad y técnicas de caza de amenazas.
* Experiencia en la gestión de incidentes de ciberseguridad y el desarrollo de playbooks de respuesta.
* Habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas excepcionales.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
* Inglés avanzado.

**Conocimientos y Experiencia Deseables**

* Experiencia con Cortex XDR, Crowdstrike, Trend Micro, McAfee, Microsoft Defender y suite de seguridad de Microsoft, entre otras.
* Conocimiento de otras tecnologías de seguridad como firewalls, IPS y DLP.
* Experiencia en la gestión de SOC (Security Operations Center).
* Certificaciones en seguridad de la información como CISSP, CEH o GSEC.

**Información adicional** *Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto. En Inetum valoramos la expertise y el conocimiento, y queremos ayudarte a llevar tu carrera al siguiente nivel en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.* *Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.* *Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.* *Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.* *El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.* *Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.*

jobs.description:
Description

SAIC has an opening for a Senior Network Engineer billet in Arlington, VA. SAIC is recognized as an IT leader in the intelligence and law enforcement spaces. This exciting opportunity will be supporting the United States Marshals Services' unique mission needs. We are seeking an individual who will be fully committed to the success of USMS programs and to bringing the best innovation, implementation, and attitudes to the position.

Description of Duties

The Senior Network Engineer serves as a technical leader responsible for design, implementation, operation, security, optimization, and lifecycle management of the enterprise network infrastructure. The candidate will engineer the secure network boundaries, access controls, and transport layers required to safely integrate the agency's enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) endpoints (iOS/Android devices).

Additionally, the candidate will

 Lead network design, project planning, budget estimations, lifecycle management, and migration/rollback strategies from planning through implementation.
 Install, configure, optimize, and maintain Cisco routers, switches, Voice/Video over IP (VoIP), Data Center, and Cisco Wireless networks using advanced protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VRF) and secure cloud network services
 Support enterprise unified communications infrastructure using Cisco CUCM, Unity Connection, SIP, CUBE, SRST, and VoIP QoS.
 Design and support data center networking solutions (Cisco Nexus, VXLAN, ACI, Virtual Switching, UCS) and bridge hardware to government cloud environments (AWS GovCloud / Azure Government).
 Architect secure network zones, gateways, and access controls to safely support traffic flow from enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms (Microsoft Intune, VMware Workspace ONE, or MobileIron) into internal law enforcement networks.
 Configure and maintain Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), 802.1X, and Network Access Control (NAC) platforms to regulate enterprise perimeter access for mobile assets and field tech.
 Implement cybersecurity best practices, network segmentation, Layer 2 security, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls in strict compliance with STIG, NIST 800-53, RMF, and Zero Trust Architecture directives.
 Engineer and troubleshoot secure site-to-site VPNs, TLS protocols, TACLANEs, and encrypted transport layers for field agents.
 Support vulnerability remediation efforts, security audits, and implement proactive monitoring/automation strategies utilizing SolarWinds, Cisco Catalyst Center (DNAC), SNMP, NetFlow, and REST APIs.
 Create and maintain 100% current network diagrams, topology mapping, SOPs, engineering standards, and change methodologies.
 Perform as a critical resource, technical liaison, and trusted advisor to customers, management, and external stakeholders regarding network capabilities, translating technical concepts into business language.
 Lead incident response, root cause analysis, backup systems, and disaster recovery planning/testing to maintain strict SLA uptimes.
 Provide technical guidance and conduct peer configuration reviews for junior engineers to promote engineering excellence and conduct quarterly knowledge-sharing sessions.

        Qualifications

Required Experience / Skills / Attributes

Education: Bachelor’s degree in an IT-related field.Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience with Cisco routers, switches, and deep expertise in LAN/WAN/WLAN facilities and protocols.Clearance & Citizenship: Active Secret clearance or above (USMS suitability requires U.S. Citizenship).Required Certifications

Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Enterprise (or equivalent).Preferred Certifications

Cisco CCIE or Cisco Certified Specialist designations.CISSP. AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate.ITIL Foundation.

 Target salary range: $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels. Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts. Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels. Risk, Controls, Privacy & Governance Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations. Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials. Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.
