Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes. Coordinate rollout, communications, training, and change management with digital channels, field/service organizations, and support teams. Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting roadmap decisions, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and funding needs to senior stakeholders. jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Graph API, and endpoint automation to drive the migration of enterprise iOS and iPadOS device management from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune.

We are seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Graph API, and endpoint automation to drive the migration of enterprise iOS and iPadOS device management from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune. The ideal candidate will combine strong mobile endpoint engineering, automation, and migration experience to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable solutions within a global enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the migration of enterprise iOS and iPadOS device management from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune, including policies, compliance controls, applications, enrollment profiles, and device lifecycle processes.

- Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell, REST APIs, and Azure automation services to improve operational efficiency and platform management.

- Engineer and support Intune mobile management capabilities including enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, reporting, and remediation activities.

- Manage Apple ecosystem integrations, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), supervised devices, Apps & Books, and managed application deployments.

- Provide advanced engineering and Level 3 support for mobile endpoint platforms, ensuring platform reliability, security, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

- Collaborate with Security, Identity, Network, and Application teams to deliver secure, compliant, and scalable endpoint management solutions while maintaining technical documentation and operational runbooks.

-
 6+ years of experience in Endpoint Management, Mobility Engineering, Modern Workplace Engineering, or a related enterprise infrastructure role.

- Proven experience leading or supporting large-scale MDM/UEM migration projects , preferably from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune.

- Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Intune administration for iOS/iPadOS, including device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, and reporting.

- Proven experience developing automation solutions using Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, JSON, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.

- Strong knowledge of Apple enterprise management, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), supervised devices, and managed application deployment.

- Experience with Conditional Access, certificate-based authentication, PKI, Git/Azure DevOps, and enterprise security best practices.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure Automation, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Power Automate, or other enterprise automation platforms.

- Experience building operational dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics.

- Knowledge of ServiceNow workflows, request management processes, and platform integrations.

- Experience with Zero Trust and mobile security technologies such as Microsoft Defender, Zscaler, Zimperium, or Lookout.

- Experience with Python or C# for API integrations, automation, and lightweight application development.

- Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or Azure Developer Associate.

We offer:

-
 Culture of Relentless Performance : join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.

-
 Competitive Pay and Benefits : enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.

-
 Growth Mindset : reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.

-
 Global Impact : collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.

-
 Welcoming Multicultural Environment : be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.

-
 Social Sustainability Values : join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

 * Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech 's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

 Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in 30+ countries around the world. We currently have R&D centers in Ukraine, India, Poland, Spain, Slovakia, Canada, and our headquarters in the US. As we continue to expand globally, we are seeing India, the United States, Canada, Argentina, and Brazil rapidly evolve into key growth areas in the Miratech network. Bowhead seeks a Windows Systems Engineer SME to join our team supporting the Program Office for NSWC Corona in Norco, California.

The Windows Systems Engineer SME will work directly with the client analyzing complex and unique technical support assignments and lead or collaborate with other system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and program analysts within an agile environment.

 The Windows Systems Engineer administers and supports daily operational requirements of computer network systems including workstation, file servers, and web servers. Serve as network SME as a leader or contributor with other network SMEs to impact network efficiency, security and the implantation of technical upgrades Installation of hardware, software, systems upgrades, network accounts, network security, and web page design, interface and updates, and local system design documentation. Applying advanced diagnostic techniques to identify problems, investigate causes and recommend solutions to correct common failures. Installation of new software releases, system upgrades, evaluation and installation of patches and to resolve software related issues and Information Assurance Vulnerabilities (IAVs). Physical Demands:

 Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged amounts of time Must be able to twist, bend and squat periodically

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. jobs.description:
Company Description
Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description
We have an opening for a Virtual Desktop Engineer/Desktop Engineer. Working closely with the Desktop Services engineering team, you will operate and support enterprise class desktop management systems used to support the mission of the lab. This position is in the Information Technology Solutions Division (ITSD) within the Computing Directorate, in support of the LivIT Program.

This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Recommend, justify, and implement operational service level improvements using an accepted change control methodology.
You will interface directly with end users and work with the engineering team in the performance of root cause analysis of reported problems.
You will work with Engineering and management in the planning of project milestones and staff expansion.
Design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner while collaborating within a diverse group.
Ensure service levels are met and highest levels of service reliability are maintained.
Define and maintain support documentation and procedures.
Be a team player, maintain appropriate technology, computer security, and safety knowledge.
Lead and mentor junior operations team members in best practices and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the 393.2 level

Manage multiple complex parallel tasks and priorities of customers and stakeholders, ensuring deadlines are met, while leveraging team member’s skills.
Leverage tools and develop procedures to improve windows configuration management services and automate various complex tasks.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Proficiency supporting VDI environments required; VMware Horizon experience preferred.
Experience effectively working in a dynamic, technical team environment with competing priorities.
Strong experience working with Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Strong PowerShell scripting skills with experience automating Windows desktop administration, configuration, software deployment, troubleshooting, reporting, or routine operational tasks.
Broad experience with SCCM/MECM application deployment.
Proficient written and verbal communication and strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of management and staff as well as outside vendors, contractors, service providers and consultants.

Additional qualifications at the 393.2 level

Substantial experience architecting and administering highly redundant and fault tolerant enterprise Windows server environments.
Advanced ability to provide innovative approaches and apply new technologies to broadly defined tasks and projects.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network environments.

Qualifications We Desire

Significant experience automating Windows Desktop builds.
Knowledge of thin client administration and support.

Pay Range

$125,310 - $153,444 Yearly at the 393.1 level

$151,620 - $185,640 Yearly at the 393.2 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information
#LI-Onsite

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
Flexible Benefits Package
401(k)
Relocation Assistance
Education Reimbursement Program
Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

Job Description

We are seeking a Solutions Engineer – Infrastructure for a Full-Time role based in California. Our client is a well-capitalized, rapidly growing enterprise cloud and high-performance infrastructure provider delivering specialized, large-scale compute environments for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Their platform leverages advanced data center engineering, high-density power and cooling architectures, accelerated compute clusters, and ultra-high-throughput networking fabrics to power modern enterprise computing.

This is an exceptional ground-floor opportunity to join an expanding commercial pre-sales organization as the core technical authority on physical and network infrastructure. The #1 feature of this opportunity is the rare combination of cutting-edge hardware scale and early-stage leadership runway: you will partner directly with commercial sales leaders to drive technical discovery, lead high-impact architectural whiteboarding, and design custom, multi-node infrastructure solutions for enterprise customers. We are looking for an adaptable, hands-on infrastructure technologist who is energized by customer engagement and motivated by a clear path into future technical leadership. You will step into a collaborative, engineering-driven environment that values autonomy, continuous learning on advanced hardware systems, and sustainable work-life balance.

Required Skills & Experience · 7+ years of experience in customer-facing pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering within enterprise data center, cloud infrastructure, or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

· Deep technical understanding of physical data center design, power planning, high-density rack topologies, and modern thermal management solutions (liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, or hybrid systems).

· Proven track record architecting and sizing enterprise compute clusters and hardware accelerator platforms.

· Solid architectural grasp of high-speed, low-latency fabric networking (such as InfiniBand or high-performance RoCE/lossless Ethernet fabrics).

· Demonstrated experience partnering with enterprise account executives through the complete pre-sales lifecycle, including discovery, technical qualification, and solution design.

· Strong executive presentation, consultative whiteboarding, and technical communication skills.

Desired Skills & Experience · Experience supporting large-scale enterprise deployments, benchmark validations, and formal technical proposals/RFPs.

· Familiarity with cluster management tools, distributed computing platforms, or high-throughput enterprise storage architectures.

· Background working with enterprise hardware vendors, systems integrators, or specialized cloud infrastructure providers.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

· 40% Data Center Power, Thermal Management & High-Density Rack Architecture

Daily Responsibilities

jobs.title: Senior System Administrator
jobs.summary: ABOUT RADIANT Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is...
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

 ABOUT THE ROLE:

Radiant is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to own the systems that keep the company running day-to-day within Microsoft 365 GCC High. You'll own the tenant, build our identity and access automation from the ground up in an Entra-native environment with no on-prem Active Directory or Group Policy, and manage the endpoint, email security, and SaaS infrastructure the business runs on. You'll implement and evidence the technical controls behind our CMMC assessment as part of the normal job, not a detour. This is a high-ownership seat in an interdisciplinary environment, advancing milestones toward commercializing the first mass-produced nuclear reactor.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

 - Own Microsoft 365 GCC High: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and the tenant configuration underneath them; be the authority on what's possible in this cloud and what has to be built in-house

 - Own Entra end-to-end: conditional access, privileged access, app registrations, and single sign-on

 - Build the IAM automation layer, the centerpiece of the role: joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, entitlements driven by HR data, provisioning through Graph and SCIM, and access reviews that run themselves

 - Own Windows and endpoint management through Intune, Autopilot, compliance policy, and update rings across the fleet, with no Group Policy underneath

 - Own email security and information protection: Defender for Office, mail flow and anti-phishing posture, and Purview for DLP, labeling, and retention in an environment handling CUI

 - Own SaaS administration and integration across the business application portfolio, including Box and Slack; some running today, some a project waiting for an owner

 - Own the workloads, services, and licensing infrastructure running in AWS, in constant contact with the IT DevOps engineer who owns the account layer

 - Take new platform projects from idea to deployed, integrated, and documented

 - Implement and evidence the technical controls in these areas for the CMMC assessment ahead, as normal work rather than a detour

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a similar field (4 years of work experience in lieu of a degree)

 - 7+ years administering and engineering production systems

 - Deep, hands-on experience across the responsibilities above: GCC High tenant administration, Entra, self-built IAM automation, Intune without Group Policy, email security and Purview, and SaaS/AWS administration

 - Solid networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, firewall policy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, wireless

 - Treats compliance control implementation and evidence collection as normal work

 - Service is the job; tier-1 handles day-to-day support, but nobody's too senior to help the person at their desk

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

 - Purview depth: DLP, sensitivity labeling, retention, or eDiscovery

 - CMMC or NIST 800-171 exposure; leading an assessment is not required

 - Stood up identity governance tooling: Entra ID Governance, SailPoint, Okta Workflows, or equivalent

 - Automation experience with PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or similar)

 - Written and maintained PowerShell modules other people use, not just scripts

 - Deployed Box, Slack, or comparable platforms into a regulated environment and handled the data boundary questions

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

 - Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children's life stories!

**Key Responsibilities** IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

* All CVs should be submitted in English.
* This position is open to candidates based in countries where World Vision International is legally registered to operate.

As an**Endpoint Engineer,** you will play a critical role in maintaining, monitoring, and supporting global IT systems and infrastructure. You will lead multiple projects, providing technical guidance to Endpoint and Systems Administrators, while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise computing platforms.

You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing the systems operating environment---including servers, storage, and backup solutions---to meet evolving business needs. Your expertise will span across technologies such as Windows, Linux, VMware, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. You will also manage access controls, security applications, and system backups, ensuring a secure and highly available environment. This role demands strong troubleshooting skills for complex hardware, software, and basic network issues. You will analyze system failures, respond to incidents, and execute contingency plans to maintain operational continuity. Additionally, you will support 24/7 operations, lead disaster recovery efforts, and manage off-site storage processes.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and collaboration skills. You will work closely with system users, technical teams, and vendors, providing expert support and training as needed. A strong customer service orientation and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level servers and IT infrastructure.
* At least 5+ years of experience designing, configuring, deploying, and optimizing server hardware and operating environments.
* 5-7 years of progressive experience in information technology, with a focus on endpoint systems and enterprise computing platforms.

**Continuation Of Major Responsibilities** **PROJECT PLANNING:**

* Leads or consults short- and long-term project planning efforts with team members, clients and other IT groups.
* Develops cost/time estimates.
* Documents discussion and agreements.

**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Works with systems engineers to understand technical requirements.

**DESIGN/DEVELOP:** Integrates solutions with other applications and platforms outside the framework.

**Maintenance**

* Performs routine maintenance tasks for infrastructure systems such as backups, patch management and hot fixes.
* Develops strategies to manage the frequency of appropriate support package/patch application.
* Monitors health of systems and provides appropriate recommendations, when required.

**Administration**

* Coordinates and validates activities.
* Manages user access to, systems, servers, and files.
* Administers the setup of new profiles, creates and updates access permissions and maintains user accounts.
* Installs, configures and maintains system hardware and software components.
* Maintains tracking and configuration documentation and plans.
* Supervising the installation of system upgrades and service packs.
* Determines if inactive accounts should be deleted.
* Administers Storage Area Network (SAN).

**Performance Monitoring**

* Supervises the monitoring procedures and evaluates problems identified by team members.
* Ensures that capacity workload modeling and availability analysis is performed.
* Monitors system-operating capacity in terms of disk space, tape storage, memory and CPU utilization.
* Reviews performance and control reports.
* Recommends settings changes to the operating system to improve performance and reliability.
* Develops, maintains, recommends, documents and supports tools and backend utilities to provide capacity planning management.

**Testing**

* Leads or provides technical direction for the planning, designing, and execution of testing efforts.
* Ensures that tests evaluate all possible impacts on the current infrastructure or application.

**Continuous Improvements**

* Recommends performance metrics.

_At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit [klaviyo.com/careers](http://klaviyo.com/careers) to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny._

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

#### **About the team:**

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Risk, and Trust teams and the broader Engineering department.

#### **About the role:**

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you own the design, implementation, and long-term health of the enterprise systems Klaviyo runs on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms every Klaviyo touches. You will lead projects end to end, from SSO/SCIM rollouts to complex multi-tool integrations and automations, and you will be trusted to take an ambiguous business problem, define the problem statement yourself, and deliver a solution that scales. You will partner with operations, engineering, Security, and the IT Searchbar team, and act as a technical escalation point when systems break.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will use AI fluently in your own work and help design AI-assisted workflows into the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a senior individual contributor role: no direct reports, high autonomy, and real ownership. We are looking for someone who has already run systems at scale, holds opinions grounded in experience, and can be handed a domain and trusted to run it.

#### **How you’ll have an impact**

- Own systems, not tickets. You will take a domain identity, endpoint, or a set of core SaaS platforms and be accountable for its reliability, security, and roadmap, raising the decisions that need to go higher and driving everything else yourself.
- Lead projects end to end at pace: scope the work, design the solution, plan the rollout and the rollback, communicate the change, and land it without skipping testing, peer review, or documentation to hit a date.
- Turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements and systems that hold up, so Klaviyos spend their time on their work instead of fighting their tools.
- Set the technical bar: clean configuration, least-privilege access by default, automation over manual toil, and runbooks the rest of the team can operate from without you in the room.
- Define what success looks like before you build, then prove it with data tickets deflected, provisioning time saved, coverage and compliance gaps closed.
- Raise the people around you: review others’ work, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and give and receive direct, useful feedback.
- Act as a technical escalation point for complex system issues, drive root cause rather than symptoms, and feed what you learn back into the platform so the same incident does not happen twice.

#### **Requirements:**

- 4+ years of hands-on experience as a systems engineer or systems administrator, with a track record of owning enterprise systems in production not just operating them, but deciding how they should work.
- You define problem statements yourself. You can take a vague or contested business need, scope it, drive alignment with stakeholders, and deliver with minimal direction without losing the thread when priorities shift.
- Deep working knowledge across a wide range of IT systems, including enterprise device management, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
- You have deployed and managed macOS and iOS devices at scale through an MDM (Jamf preferred), including configuration profiles, policies, and OS update strategy. Windows management (Intune, Autopilot) is a strong plus.
- You have administered core SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Zoom, including their security and admin controls.
- Hands-on experience with IdP configuration, management, and maintenance: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group and role design, and app onboarding. Experience with Okta or Entra ID (Azure AD) is preferred.
- You have owned the identity lifecycle in practice onboarding, role changes, and offboarding and understand the security and audit consequences of getting it wrong.
- AI proficiency: AI is already part of how you work, and you can show it. You use LLM assistants and agents to research, write and debug code, draft documentation, and compress routine work, and you exercise judgment about when to trust the output. You are actively interested in putting AI into the systems you run automating triage, enrichment, and repetitive workflows for the wider company.
- You automate by default, and you have the scripting skills to do it: Bash, PowerShell, or Python. Python is preferred and AWS Lambda experience is a plus. You have replaced manual, repetitive work with automation other people now rely on, and you can safely read and modify someone else’s script.
- Comfortable working with APIs REST, JSON, authentication, and rate limits and building integrations between systems that do not natively talk to each other.
- You value clean, concise controls and easily editable security functionality within tools, and you can produce evidence for access reviews and audits (SOC 2, SOX) without it derailing your week.
- Disciplined change management: you test, get peer review, plan rollback, communicate to affected users, and document what changed including under pressure.
- You can debug a system problem you have never seen before, drive it to the root cause, and communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders while it is still unresolved.
- You can evaluate vendors and tools on their merits: security posture, integration surface, total cost and make a defensible recommendation.
- Strong written communication. Your documentation, runbooks, and change notices are good enough that other people can act on them without asking you.
- Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site-specific or business-blocking issues.

#### **Nice to have**

- You have worked with Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or other similar SSO and automation solutions, and have built something non-trivial in one.
- Experience with enterprise-scale networking topics, including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and building and maintaining multiple global office networks.
- Experience as a systems administrator or systems engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth IT environment, ideally supporting a globally distributed workforce.
- Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or running an AI-assisted workflow or agent in production.
- Experience with VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM in AWS and GCP.
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) or version-controlled configuration management for IT systems.
- Experience administering an ITSM platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, SLAs, and reporting.
- Relevant certifications such as Jamf 200/300, Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, or associate-level AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

 Our philosophy:

- We believe in relentless automation of repetitive tasks.

- We have the curiosity and drive to dig deep and find creative solutions.

- We believe our goal is to find the right solution rather than always being right.

- We provide exceptional customer service to our teams and trading desks.

- We care more that the right thing is done than about rigid job descriptions or boundaries.

 What you’ll do:

- Administer core Microsoft services: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange (on-premise, Online, hybrid).

- Deploy, maintain and support Windows Server environments (2016–2025).

- Support Microsoft cloud services (Entra ID, OneDrive, Copilot, Microsoft 365 services).

- Configure single sign on and federation (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM).

- Triage and resolve tickets from the operations queue; respond to critical production incidents.

- Implement planned and ad hoc changes in accordance with firmwide change management processes.

- Maintain clear system documentation and capture specialized configurations as repeatable runbooks.

- Participate in a global support team with on call rotation and occasional weekend maintenance.

 Your background:

- Experience managing Windows Server infrastructure in high visibility, mission critical environments.

- Experience administering Windows Server services: Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Failover Clustering.

- Experience with Entra ID, Exchange (Server/Online/Hybrid) and MECM (SCCM) is preferred.

- You can use scripts (e.g. PowerShell, Python) to automate routine administrative tasks.

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, server hardware and VM deployments.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can work across teams and have evidence-based discussions on technical and operational topics.

- You are eager to learn, collaborate, and find solutions under interesting constraints.

 Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Alertmanager, Prometheus.

- Familiarity with DevOps/CI CD and IaC practices, containerization and Kubernetes.

- Prior experience in the trading or financial services industry.

The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $160,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.description:
## **Who are we?**

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

**Role Overview**

The Microsoft 365 Architect at Finastra is a senior, hands-on engineering and operations role responsible for the design and day-to-day management of the global Microsoft 365 environment. This role combines strategic platform architecture with practical administration and L3/L4 support, ensuring services are secure, reliable, and aligned with business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Architecture & Design: Define and evolve architecture for M365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
- Governance & Compliance: Establish tenant-wide policies for data protection, retention, and regulatory compliance.
- Platform Administration & Monitoring: Administer and troubleshoot M365 services to ensure performance and availability.

Job Title: Microsoft Systems Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Summary: We are seeking a Microsoft Systems Engineer with real-world, hands-on experience managing modern Microsoft cloud environments. This role focuses on endpoint management, identity, tenant integrations, and automation, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, cross-tenant integrations, Power Automate, and AI-driven automation. This is a production-focused role supporting live tenants.

Key Responsibilities:

Microsoft Endpoint & Identity Management

Administer and manage Microsoft Intune across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android
Configure compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment
Manage Entra ID including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, and identity lifecycle
Integrate Intune with Conditional Access and Defender for policy enforcement
Tenant & System Integrations

Manage Microsoft 365 tenant integrations and cross-tenant access (B2B)
Configure app registrations and secure API access
Support tenant-to-tenant migrations and coexistence scenarios
Automation & AI-Driven Operations

Build workflows using Power Automate for onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management
Use PowerShell to support and extend automation scenarios
Leverage AI and Copilot-based tools to improve operational efficiency and standardization
Security & Operations

Support Conditional Access and device compliance
Troubleshoot access, device, and policy conflicts in live environments
Document standards, procedures, and automation workflows
Required Qualifications:

4-7+ years of experience in Microsoft systems administration, endpoint engineering, or Microsoft 365 infrastructure support
Strong hands-on production experience with Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, update rings, Autopilot, and endpoint security baselines across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android
Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, enterprise applications, app registrations, service principals, SSO, access reviews, and identity lifecycle management
Proficiency with PowerShell automation and troubleshooting, including scripting for provisioning, reporting, remediation, and administrative task automation
Experience building and maintaining workflows using Power Automate for onboarding, offboarding, approval, notification, and operational process automation
Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender, endpoint compliance, tenant security posture, and troubleshooting policy conflicts in live environments
Ability to document standards, runbooks, implementation steps, rollback plans, and operational procedures with a production-support mindset

Required Certifications:

Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
Microsoft 365 Certified : Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-102)

Preferred Qualifications:

MSP, consulting, or multi-tenant experience, including migration, coexistence, cross-tenant access, and high-volume operational support, is highly desirable
Additional Microsoft certifications in Microsoft 365 administration, identity and access, security, or Azure are preferred

Hands-On Production Requirements:

This role requires recent, hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting live Microsoft 365 production tenants. Candidates should be comfortable making controlled changes in production, validating impact, following change management processes, and supporting business-critical systems with minimal disruption.
Qualified candidates should demonstrate direct ownership of endpoint enrollment, policy deployment, Conditional Access rollouts, application packaging and deployment, Autopilot provisioning, access troubleshooting, incident response, and post-change validation in production environments. Experience supporting multiple tenants, documenting runbooks, and participating in on-call or escalation support is strongly preferred.

Job Summary

The Server and Endpoint Operations Manager ensures the streamlined daily operation of server infrastructure and staff applications, information, and security objectives. This position plans, coordinates, directs, and designs server infrastructure related activities, as well as provides administrative direction and support for daily operational activities. The Server & Endpoint Operations Manager works closely with decision makers in other departments to identify, recommend, develop, implement, and support cost-effective technology solutions. The Server and Endpoint Operations Manager also acts as the lead Desktop Support Manager to provide systems and processes that support efficient provisioning, control and monitoring of hardware and software for assigned area users and devices.

Essential Functions

Infrastructure Management:

Ensures the streamlined operation of server infrastructure and staff in alignment with application, information, and security objectives by monitoring systems and ensuring they remain current with upgrades and the latest technologies

Plans, coordinates, directs, and designs server infrastructure related activities, as well as provides administrative direction and support for daily operational activities.

Manages and monitors server operating systems ensuring all servers are properly updated and patched with the latest security releases.

Implements and maintains disaster recovery and business continuity plans, including regular testing and updates.

Conducts capacity planning for server infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and resource utilization.

Ensures appropriate system availability, manageability, scalability, and security through implementation of best practices and regular auditing.

Manages printers, scanners, and fax machines, including procurement, configuration, maintenance, and disposal.

Ensures all devices are operational and meet departmental needs.

Manages and oversees the department's VOIP solution and call center software such as Microsoft Teams Phone and Landis Contact Center.

System Administration:

Creates and develops new system images and facilitates software upgrade schedules with DevOps engineer.

Manages computers, users, groups, group policy, and provides maintenance and support related to Active Directory / Entra ID services.

Configures and maintains file shares, database and application backups, with regular testing of restore processes.

Manages Dell KACE and antivirus/EDR applications, including application and patch deployment, antivirus management, and system monitoring. Implements and maintains monitoring and logging solutions for proactive system management.

Security and Compliance:

Conducts regular security assessments and vulnerability scanning.

Leads incident response efforts for major system outages or security incidents.

Ensures compliance with IT security frameworks and institutional requirements.

Analyzes system workflows to identify and mitigate potential points of failure.

Manages and maintains security tools and endpoint protection platforms.

Leadership and Management:

Acts as the lead Desktop Support Manager.

Provides mentorship and technical guidance to junior team members.

Coordinates with departments and outside vendors/agencies for procurement and services.

Creates and maintains policy and procedure documentation.

Acts as liaison to UMass IT Admins and manages vendor relationships.

Technical Development:

Develops tools for automation of tasks using available scripting and programming languages.

Maintains expertise in emerging computing technologies and techniques.

Acts as a Tier 2 (L2) escalation point, assisting Tier 1 (L1) technicians in resolving complex technical issues to maintain operational efficiency, and communicates with team effectively to facilitate the resolution of service requests within set Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards.

Implements and maintains infrastructure as code and configuration management solutions.

Administrative:

Acts as the IT Equipment Coordinator/Purchaser for assigned areas.

Collaborates with assigned areas on budgetary resources and projected expenditures.

Develops and maintains system documentation and standard operating procedures.

Creates and delivers technical training materials as needed.

Other Functions

Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Degree with two (2) years related experience or Bachelor's Degree with four (4) years of related experience or Associate's Degree with seven (7) years of related experience or High School diploma/GED with nine (9) years of related experience.

Experience in installation, maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting of current Windows operating systems, applications, and network client software.

Proficiency in managing physical and virtual server infrastructure.

Experience with TCP/IP networking, IPAM, VPN and firewall management.

Proven experience with Microsoft Active Directory and ENTRA ID or similar tools. Experience with relational databases and object-oriented programming.

Knowledge of backup and recovery solutions.

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions.

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, and AWS.

Understanding of IT security frameworks and compliance requirements. Demonstrated strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

Excellent project management and organizational abilities.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Excellent oral and written communication skills, particularly in explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a technical team leader with demonstrated project management experience.

Relevant certifications (MCSE, CompTIA Server+, Azure certifications).

Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation tools.

Knowledge of ITIL frameworks and IT service management principles.

Experience with PeopleSoft, SLATE, Salesforce, Perceptive Content, Softdocs, K1000, K2000, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender.

Experience managing Microsoft SQL and Oracle databases. Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker).

Experience with infrastructure as code tools (Ansible).

Reporting to the Manager, Corporate IT in our NYC Global HQ, the Sr. Corporate Systems Engineer owns end-to-end administration and governance of DoubleVerify's core collaboration stack — Google Workspace and Slack — across roughly 300–400 users and ~100 applications, for a C-suite-heavy headquarters (our CEO, COO, and CFO are in-office regularly).

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end administration and governance of Google Workspace and Slack — user and group lifecycle, Drive and shared-drive permissions, channel governance, domain-wide delegation, app security controls, security and compliance settings, third-party integrations, and guest access.Own conference room AV and collaboration technology across the NYC HQ footprint — from hardware rollouts and new conferencing standards (Crestron, Neat, Zoom Rooms, WebEx, Logitech, DisplayLink) through day-to-day reliability, not just break-fix troubleshooting.Own MDM/endpoint management across ~100 applications and 300–400 users, using tools such as Jamf and Workspace ONE.Provide direct, white-glove technical support to C-level executives and leadership — ensuring rapid, discreet, and reliable resolution of their technology needs across devices, collaboration tools, and conferencing.Own the Corporate Systems ticketing queue end-to-end — triaging, prioritizing, and resolving within SLA, and building automations that measurably reduce recurring ticket volume or support time.Build and maintain the department knowledge base — SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and self-service documentation to deflect tickets and standardize resolutions.

About You

We're looking for someone who has been the sole, accountable owner of a Workspace or Slack environment at a prior company — not someone who has helped administer one as part of a shared team. Alongside platform governance, this role owns conference room AV, MDM/endpoint management, and ITSM/ticketing automation, and provides white-glove technical support directly to executive leadership. This is a highly technical, high-trust role that requires both deep hands-on expertise and the judgment and composure to operate in close proximity to senior executives.

Required Experience & Skills

5+ years of hands-on Google Workspace and Slack platform administration/ownership experience — not general IT support tenure.Proven, sole ownership of Google Workspace governance, including domain-wide delegation and app-blocking for security, with real hands-on GAM/Admin console scripting for bulk user and group management (not shadowing).Has built or shipped something on Slack itself — an app, bot, or workflow — not just configured channels and permissions.Has owned a conference room AV project end-to-end — a hardware rollout or new conferencing standard — not just occasional troubleshooting.Hands-on MDM/endpoint management at scale using Jamf and/or Workspace ONE.Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (Freshservice, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or equivalent), including having personally built an automation with a measurable, data-backed reduction in ticket volume or support time.Strong experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS and Windows.Genuine white-glove executive support experience.

Preferred Experience & Skills

Okta experience beyond basic app assignment — provisioning rules, SCIM, or group-based access management.Experience with IT onboarding processes and hardware logistics.Experience with enterprise conferencing platforms (Google Meet, Zoom, MS Teams).

This position is full-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV.

The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $94,000 $160,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Modern Endpoint Engineer
jobs.summary: SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®,...
jobs.description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Associate Manager, Modern Endpoint Engineer, you will drive modernization and technical direction for a highly visible endpoint platform, ensuring solutions meet business needs while balancing security, supportability, and end-user experience. This role also owns key architecture deliverables within the Endpoint space.

The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with accountability for architecture governance, operating model discipline, and design quality—ensuring solutions are scalable, aligned to standards, and consistently executed.

You will partner closely with the Endpoint Manager and engineering team to drive roadmap alignment, solution design, and execution across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

This role works cross-functionally—particularly with InfoSec (GIS)—to integrate modern deployment solutions and cloud-first strategies, supporting project delivery, M&A activity, and ongoing operational needs.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

-
Lead endpoint solutioning across Windows, macOS, and mobile, combining hands-on engineering expertise with conceptual and logical architecture design

-
Define and enforce endpoint architecture governance, including standards, templates, checklists, policies, and quality frameworks

-
Define and manage endpoint roadmap, including feature prioritization, vendor insights, roadmap cadence, and improvement of project submission and resource estimation quality

-
Partner with engineering teams to validate feasibility, guide PoCs, and ensure solutions align with architecture standards and enterprise design expectations

-
Develop and maintain deep expertise in the endpoint ecosystem, including hardware, OS, applications, security, and end-user experience considerations

-
Set and monitor MSP standards, SLAs/XLAs, and performance metrics while ensuring adherence to security policies and infrastructure management processes

-
Guide teams on architecture practices and collaborate across teams to drive consistent execution, continuous improvement, and resolution of complex technical issues, including leading major incident response, engaging vendors, and providing on-call support as needed

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

-
University Degree and 5+ years of relevant experience

-
5+ years of experience in the Endpoint and Desktop Management space including but not limited to systems design, implementation and support.

  -
Strong understanding of Modern Device Management concepts, the Digital Workspace Industry direction, Enterprise sized Endpoint ecosystem use cases, including Windows OS, Mac OS, and Mobile concepts.

-
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated experience in two or more of the following:

  -
Administration, configuration and design for Modern Endpoint Management (Microsoft Intune, JAMF)

  -
Experience working with at least two of the following: Active Directory, Microsoft Azure AD, SCCM, GPO, or CPC

-
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship for full-time employment.

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS

•Transformative experience with Endpoint services in medium to large sized company.

•Experience in mergers and acquisitions work.

•Proven track record of a cross team collaborative approach

•Experience with Microsoft Office 365

•Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to overcome difficult challenges

•Strong interpersonal and team building skills

•Microsoft and/or Intune certifications are a plus

 JOB REQUIREMENTS

-
Full Time- regular schedule for corporate

-
Remote work available once a week after 90-day onboarding period.

-
This role is not eligible for relocation

 BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, long-term incentives, matching 401(k) contributions and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, vacation purchase options, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

 Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion .

 Better Together

   At SC Johnson, we believe people achieve their best when they collaborate and work together in person. We value connection to strengthen teamwork, accelerate problem solving, and drive innovation.

 Equal Opportunity Employer

The policy of the Company is to ensure equal opportunity for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in any active or reserve component of the U.S. or state military forces, genetic history or information or any other category protected by law.

 Accommodation Requests

If you are an individual with a disability and you need an accommodation or other assistance during the application process, please call our Human Resources department at 262-260-3343 or email your request to SCJHR@scj.com . All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. Download the EEO Know Your Rights poster for more information.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
Ready to shape the future of the digital workplace and deliver a seamless technology experience for employees around the globe?

IFF is a global leader in food ingredients, flavors, fragrances, and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.

The role is based in St. Louis, Missouri or Union Beach, New Jersey, with consideration for a U.S.-based hybrid work arrangement. Be part of a strategic, solution-oriented, collaborative team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
 Where You'll Make a Difference

- Define and execute the global endpoint management strategy and roadmap supporting approximately 6,000 employees.

- Establish standards, policies, and lifecycle management practices for endpoint technologies.

- Lead Windows 11, Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Manager, Autopilot, and Entra ID environments.

- Drive automation and operational efficiency through PowerShell and modern management practices.

- Own the strategy and effectiveness of the Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) platform.

- Partner with security, infrastructure, service management, and regional IT teams.

- Oversee vendor relationships, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).

- Lead endpoint modernization, refresh programs, and business transformation activities.

- Govern enterprise mobile device management and print services globally.

 What Makes You the Right Fit

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

- 8+ years of experience managing enterprise endpoint technologies.

- Deep expertise in Windows endpoint engineering and device management.

- Advanced knowledge of Intune, Endpoint Manager, Autopilot, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365.

- Experience supporting Citrix Virtual Desktop Infrastructure environments.

- Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, and Zero Trust principles.

- Experience managing iOS and Android mobile device platforms.

- Demonstrated success managing vendors and outsourced providers.

- Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

 How Would You Stand Out?

- Experience with Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop.

- Knowledge of ITIL service management practices and enterprise print solutions.

- Experience leading large-scale workplace transformation initiatives.

 Why Choose Us?

- Competitive Benefits (US): Competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive health and wellness programs. Our benefit package includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), vacation, holidays, 16 weeks paid parental leave (maternity/paternity), and an annual bonus plan. IFF was also recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Greatest Workplaces for Perks & Benefits.

- Diversity & Inclusion (US): IFF has been recognized previously in the US on the Disability Equality Index® – Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion

- Innovation: Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and trailblazing advancements in food ingredients solutions and protection. Meaningful work helping advance solutions for the food ingredients industry.

- Global Collaboration: Be part of a global organization that values innovation, creativity, and collaborating amongst our diverse, cross-functional teams.

- Sustainability: Contribute to solutions that support a safer, healthier, and more sustainable world. IFF was recognized on the Forbes Net Zero Leaders 2026 list within the chemicals/materials sector.

 For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is currently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. ​ The Food Ingredient business unit will remain part of IFF until close and, at such time, will transition to CVC Capital Partners. By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge awareness that the role is part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,660 hotels in operation and under development in 100+ countries. The Group's overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature *Yes I Can!* service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description
- --------------

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Master Data Management Intern to join our Data Governance and MDM team. This role offers hands-on experience in managing, analysing, and improving enterprise data, while supporting key business processes and digital transformation initiatives.

++Key responsibilities include:++

- Assisting in data collection, cleansing, and validation activities to maintain high data quality

- Supporting master data creation, updates, and enrichment across systems (ERP, CRM, etc.)

- Helping with data quality analysis and reporting using tools like Excel, SQL, or Power BI dashboards

- Documenting data processes, workflows, and governance standards

- Collaborating with business users and IT teams to resolve data-related issues

- Participating in MDM-related projects, including testing and process improvement initiatives

**Start date**: October

**Duration**: 6 months

Qualifications
- -------------

- Eligibility to sign an internship agreement with an academic institution

- Proficiency in English

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field

- Basic understanding of databases, data management concepts, or data analytics

- Proficiency in MS Excel; exposure to SQL, Python, or Power BI tools is a plus

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment

- Good communication and collaboration skills

Additional Information
- ---------------------

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development---helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that's inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference---in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks - No matter where you're located, you'll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you'll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide

Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends \& Family

Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food \& Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you're ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's make every moment matter.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

*The description of functions is merely indicative and not exhaustive. Accordingly, the student shall perform any other duties inherent to the labour position and their professional group, in accordance with the company's directives.*
