jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, and cloud services to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Operating Systems Engineer to build and harden the OS foundations for OpenAI products. We are especially interested in experienced, passionate, and innovative operating systems developers who thrive on building foundational platform software and solving hard problems in security, privacy, performance, power, and reliability. You will work across the OS kernel, core OS services, security and privacy primitives, performance and power, and the frameworks that connect applications and UI to the system. This role emphasizes deep debugging and systems ownership from development through production.

You will collaborate closely with embedded, firmware, hardware, application, and product engineering teams. Experience with hardware bring-up is a plus, but not required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Work on end-to-end OS capabilities spanning the OS kernel, userspace services, application frameworks, UI toolkits, and application-facing APIs.

 - Develop, integrate, and maintain OS components, both kernel-bound and in userspace, including scheduling, memory management, filesystems, drivers, IPC/RPC mechanisms, and security-relevant subsystems.

 - Build and maintain core OS services and daemons (init, service management, device discovery, networking primitives, time, logging, update hooks, crash handling, and so on).

 - Design and implement security and privacy mechanisms:

   - Secure boot and measured boot integration points (where applicable).

   - Mandatory access control and sandboxing.

   - Secrets management, secure storage, key handling, and least-privilege service design.

   - Privacy-preserving telemetry, data minimization, and user-consent oriented system behaviors.

 - Establish a performance and power discipline:

   - Instrumentation, profiling, and regression detection for boot time, latency, throughput, and memory.

   - Power measurement workflows, battery and thermal aware tuning, and energy regression prevention.

 - Build first-class debugging and observability for the OS:

   - Tracing and profiling using tools such as ftrace, perf, eBPF, BPFtrace, LTTng, systemtap, flamegraphs.

     - Crash triage and root cause analysis across kernel and userspace, including postmortem tooling and symbolication.

 - Provide stable, well-documented platform interfaces for application frameworks and UI frameworks:

   - Windowing/compositing primitives (e.g., Wayland), input pipelines, graphics stack integration (e.g., DRM/KMS), and UI performance.

   - System APIs for permissions, notifications, background execution, storage, device access, and lifecycle management.

 - Contribute to reliability and release readiness:

   - Production hardening, incident response participation, and cross-team debugging.

   - Test strategy across unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop environments; improve coverage and reduce flakiness.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Strong experience with systems programming (such as with Linux, BSD, etc), including meaningful work in the kernel (drivers, core subsystems, or platform enablement) and operating systems.

 - Professional proficiency in C, C++ for low-level systems development.

 - Experience building or maintaining core OS services and platform software (system services, daemons, init/service management, device management, logging/telemetry pipelines).

 - Track record of debugging complex issues across kernel/userspace boundaries using tracing, profiling, and structured root cause analysis.

 - Familiarity with security fundamentals in OS design: isolation boundaries, privilege separation, secure IPC, attack surface reduction, and vulnerability mitigation practices.

STRONGLY PREFERRED

 - Production experience with Rust in systems contexts (kernel-adjacent tooling, userspace services, security-sensitive components, or performance-critical libraries).

 - Experience with OS security hardening: SELinux/AppArmor policy, sandboxing, seccomp, namespaces/cgroups, secure boot chains, exploit mitigations.

 - Experience setting up and operationalizing observability: eBPF-based tooling, perf pipelines, automated regression detection.

 - Performance and power optimization experience, including measurement methodology (power rails, battery instrumentation, thermal constraints) and closed-loop tuning.

 - Experience supporting application or UI frameworks at the OS boundary (Wayland/compositors, graphics pipeline performance, input latency, lifecycle/permission models).

NICE TO HAVE

 - Hardware bring-up exposure (bootloader/early boot debugging, device tree/ACPI, board revisions, peripheral enablement), even if not your primary background.

 - Experience with OTA/update systems, partitioning strategies, rollback/health checks, and update security (signing, provenance).

 - Experience contributing to upstream open source projects (Linux kernel, system components) and managing long-lived downstream patches responsibly.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The OS is secure by default, privacy-preserving, and designed for least privilege.

 - Performance and power characteristics are measurable, repeatable, and continuously improved with low regression rates.

 - Debugging is fast: tracing, logs, crash artifacts, and metrics make issues diagnosable in development and in the field.

 - Application and UI teams have stable, well-documented system interfaces that enable high-quality product experiences.

WORKING STYLE

 - You take ownership across boundaries: kernel, services, tooling, and the interfaces that applications rely on.

 - You are comfortable making careful tradeoffs between security, privacy, performance, power, and developer velocity.

 - You communicate clearly with partner teams and can translate low-level findings into actionable changes.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Job Title: Windows Endpoint Engineer, Senior

Job Summary: The Windows Endpoint Engineer, Senior is responsible for managing and maintaining enterprise Windows-based endpoint environments using Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM), Microsoft Intune, and IBM BigFix for our NIH client. This role implements patching, application deployment, and system compliance to ensure secure and efficient workstation and laptop operations across the organization. The position serves as a Tier-3 escalation point, providing expert-level troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and advanced technical support for complex endpoint issues. Collaboration with the Client Security Team and Server Team is essential to support imaging, Group Policy management, and server patching initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical proficiency, hands-on experience with endpoint management platforms, and exceptional problem-solving and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Endpoint Management and Administration

    Administer, monitor, and maintain Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM), Microsoft Intune, and IBM BigFix to ensure comprehensive management of workstations and laptops across the enterprise.
    Monitor system health and performance in Ivanti, Intune, and BigFix.
    Track and manage incidents, service requests, and changes using Ivanti Service Manager, with proven ability and experience executing the same functions through Microsoft Intune.

Patching and Compliance

    Implement Windows and third-party application patching using Ivanti and Intune, including testing, deployment, and compliance reporting.
    Develop and maintain automated patching schedules across all platforms to ensure timely remediation of vulnerabilities and alignment with security policies.

Application Deployment and Configuration

    Package and deploy applications via Ivanti, Intune, and BigFix, ensuring consistency and reliability across environments.
    Provide assistance to the server team as needed in server image creation and deployment, software package creation and deployment, and server patching.
    Collaborate with the Client Security Team on Group Policy Objects (GPOs), user profiles, imaging, and endpoint configurations within Active Directory.

Support and Troubleshooting

    Serve as the final escalation point for complex end-user and Windows endpoint issues, providing Tier-3 technical support with advanced diagnostics, root cause analysis, and expert-level troubleshooting and resolution.
    Troubleshoot endpoint connectivity, software deployment, and patching issues across distributed environments.

Documentation and Training

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, patching procedures, and configuration standards.
    Facilitate hands-on training sessions for all staff members on Ivanti and Intune software, ensuring comprehensive understanding and effective usage.

Requirements

    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
    Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Windows-based endpoint administration, desktop engineering, or systems management within a medium to large enterprise environment.

        3+ years of experience with Ivanti products and solutions.
        1+ years of experience with Intune products and solutions
        2 – 3+ years of experience with BigFix products and solutions.

    Certifications:

        CompTIA Security+ (required)
        Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (nice to have)

    Hands-on experience providing mentorship and training.
    Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting Windows operating systems and executing software patching to ensure system stability and security.
    Experienced in performing server patching and updates to maintain optimal performance and compliance across environments. (preferred)
    Excellent communication and customer service skills.
    Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Compensation and Benefits

The projected compensation range for this position is $100,000 to $125,000 per year benchmarked in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. Salary at LCG is determined by various factors, including but not limited to role, location, the combination of education/training, knowledge, skills, competencies, certifications, and work experience.

Plan, design, execute, and document comprehensive Windows endpoint hardware, software, configuration, and deployment validation within an enterprise IT test lab.Test and validate enterprise Windows Deployment (OSD), task sequences, boot images, driver packages, and related configurations.Perform application compatibility testing across supported enterprise Windows configurations and identify issues that could affect pilot or production deployment.Test and validate Windows patches, software updates, security updates, and releases prior to enterprise deployment.Test Group Policy (GPO), configuration baselines, endpoint security settings, and other Windows configuration changes.Validate drivers, firmware/BIOS, hardware configurations, and peripheral compatibility within JOB SUMMARY

Our client is an organization operating in a regulated, industrial environment with field-operations and distributed workforce needs. The company relies on enterprise-grade Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity platforms to enable secure, scalable communication, knowledge management, and AI-driven productivity across its workforce.

The Digital Workplace Architect owns the organization's Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity ecosystem, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Search, and Power Platform governance. This role establishes secure, scalable standards for collaboration, AI enablement, automation, records, external sharing, and workforce productivity.

REQUIREMENTS

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent experience considered.

· Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting, administering, engineering, and supporting enterprise Microsoft 365 solutions, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Power Platform governance.

· Strong knowledge of SharePoint information architecture, permissions, search, content management, governance, and site lifecycle.

· Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectures, technical standards, implementation plans, and operating models.

· Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Microsoft Graph, APIs, integration patterns, and automation.

· Excellent communication, facilitation, prioritization, influence, and execution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in a regulated, industrial, or field-operations environment.

· Experience establishing centers of excellence, champion programs, citizen-developer guardrails, or enterprise adoption programs.

· Relevant Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, SC-100, SC-400, or current Microsoft Copilot and AI credentials.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Microsoft 365 Architecture & Strategy

· Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration roadmap, reference architectures, technical standards, and lifecycle strategy.

· Architect secure, scalable solutions across SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft Search, Copilot, and approved integrations.

SharePoint Online, Content & Knowledge Architecture

· Serve as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online architecture, administration, and modernization.

· Design information architecture, hub structures, taxonomy, metadata, content types, search, permissions, and provisioning standards.

· Govern SharePoint site creation, ownership, external sharing, guest access, and lifecycle standards.

· Lead content migration and modernization efforts while keeping content organized, discoverable, secure, and governed.

Microsoft 365 Copilot & AI Enablement

· Lead readiness, governance, architecture, and adoption for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

· Assess permissions hygiene, oversharing risk, search quality, retention controls, and compliance readiness before AI enablement.

· Define standards for Copilot usage, AI-enabled solutions, enterprise search, approved connectors, and future agent governance.

· Partner with stakeholders to prioritize high-value AI use cases while balancing innovation, security, governance, and business value.

Governance, Security, Compliance & Risk

· Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Records Management to define and enforce governance.

· Design controls for least-privilege administration, access reviews, external collaboration, guest access, and permissions governance.

· Own Power Platform governance standards and identify security, operational, legal, privacy, and governance risks.

Engineering, Automation & Operational Excellence

· Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, administrative portals, and automation to improve governance, reporting, maintenance, and operations.

· Perform discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational transition activities.

· Define monitoring, resiliency, release management, support requirements, and service health standards.

· Create documentation, mentor administrators and citizen developers, and promote governed adoption and platform standardization.

BENEFITS

Medical, dental, vision, coverage in addition to life and disability insurance plans.Paid Vacation Days and Paid Holidays.Retirement and Savings (401K) Plan with Company match.Referral bonus with no cap on amount of referrals.Paid Training.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

 Box(NYSE: BOX)は インテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では23,000社超および日経225の86%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。

 Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアにも拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

 Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

  WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

 Box Japan は、日本企業のコンテンツ活用と AI 活用を次のステージへ進めるフェーズにあります。 Enterprise Solutions Engineer は、経営・ IT ・現場それぞれの課題を理解し、 Box のプラットフォーム価値を業務成果に結びつける技術パートナーです。

 西日本エリアの民間大手企業（従業員数2000名以上）を担当するEnterprise Solutions Engineeringチーム の一員として、営業、カスタマーサクセス、プロフェッショナルサービス、パートナーと連携し、構想策定から技術検証、導入、定着・拡張までお客様の変革を支援します。

- 経営／業務課題に紐づくデモ、ワークショップ、テクニカルディスカッション

- PoC 、パイロット、アーキテクチャ設計、価値検証のリード

 WHO YOU ARE

すなわち、常に成長マインドセットを持ちながら仕事に取り組み、AIを活用し、より迅速かつ適切な意思決定を行い、インパクトを高める方法を見つけていくことが求められます。

jobs.title: Técnico/a SCCM/INTUNE
jobs.summary: Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y...
jobs.description:
Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y evolución de la plataforma de gestión de dispositivos, garantizando el despliegue seguro y eficiente de sistemas operativos, aplicaciones y políticas corporativas. Las funciones están alineadas con actividades de despliegue, empaquetado, distribución de software y gestión del ciclo de vida del puesto de trabajo identificadas en documentación interna.

Las responsabilidades principales del puesto son las siguientes:

* Administración y soporte de plataformas SCCM y Microsoft Intune.
* Gestión del ciclo de vida de dispositivos Windows.
* Despliegue y distribución de aplicaciones mediante SCCM e Intune.
* Creación, validación y mantenimiento de paquetes de software.
* Administración de políticas de configuración y cumplimiento (Compliance Policies).
* Implementación y mantenimiento de Configuration Profiles.
* Gestión de Windows Update for Business y despliegue de actualizaciones.
* Soporte en proyectos de migración de SCCM hacia Intune y Modern Workplace.
* Diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con la gestión de endpoints.
* Automatización de tareas mediante PowerShell.
* Elaboración y mantenimiento de documentación técnica.
* Coordinación con equipos de soporte, seguridad y workplace.

Requisitos obligatorios

Experiencia

* Mínimo 3 años administrando SCCM y/o Microsoft Intune.
* Experiencia en despliegue de aplicaciones y sistemas operativos.
* Experiencia en troubleshooting de entornos Windows empresariales.
* Experiencia en gestión de inventario hardware y software.

Conocimientos técnicos

* Microsoft SCCM / MECM.
* Microsoft Intune.
* Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
* Windows 10 y Windows 11.
* Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Microsoft 365.
* PowerShell.
* Gestión de GPOs y su transición a políticas modernas de Intune.
* Compliance Policies y Security Baselines.
* Conocimientos de Autopilot (muy valorables).

Requisitos valorables

* Experiencia en proyectos de migración SCCM → Intune.
* Conocimientos de Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Certificaciones Microsoft:
*

* MD-102 Endpoint Administrator.

* AZ-104 Azure Administrator.

* MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator.
* Experiencia en integración con ServiceNow.
* Conocimientos de Nexthink u otras soluciones DEX.

Competencias personales

* Capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas.
* Orientación al cliente y al servicio.
* Capacidad de documentación y organización.
* Trabajo en equipo y colaboración multidisciplinar.
* Proactividad e iniciativa.
* Capacidad para trabajar en entornos internacionales.

Perfil ideal

Profesional con experiencia sólida en la administración de SCCM e Intune, habituado a gestionar grandes volúmenes de dispositivos corporativos, despliegues masivos de software, automatización mediante PowerShell y proyectos de modernización del puesto de trabajo basados en Microsoft 365 y Endpoint Management.

jobs.title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - foco em Endpoint (Operação)
jobs.summary: **Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão. Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com...
jobs.description:
**Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão.

Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com nossos clientes. Chamamos esse espaço de Território de Proteção: um ambiente onde a segurança da informação permite que as empresas trabalhem com tranquilidade, foco e produtividade.

Nosso propósito é simples e poderoso: proporcionar paz para o ambiente corporativo.

Nossa cultura é inspirada no conceito Teknoporã, uma adaptação do "bem viver", que conecta tecnologia, equilíbrio e colaboração. Acreditamos em relações de parceria, respeito e confiança, dentro e fora da empresa.

Aqui, nos vemos como uma tribo de guardiões digitais, profissionais que unem conhecimento, atitude e conexão para proteger o ambiente digital dos nossos clientes com leveza, responsabilidade e excelência técnica.

Se você acredita que tecnologia também pode ser humana, colaborativa e feita com propósito, a XSITE pode ser o seu lugar 🌳✨

**Descrição da vaga:** Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados que queiram se desenvolver na área de Segurança da Informação e evoluir sua carreira em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo!

Foco da vaga: Endpoint Security para atuar na proteção de estações de trabalho e servidores contra ameaças avançadas, no nosso time de Operações (MSSP/SOC).

**Principais Atividades**

* Gerenciamento e Proteção de Endpoints:
* Administração e configuração de soluções de segurança para endpoints (EPP, EDR, XDR).
* Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes relacionados a malwares, ransomware e ameaças avançadas.
* Aplicação de políticas de segurança para controle de acesso, firewall local e regras de execução de aplicações.
* Gerenciamento de soluções como Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Trellix, FortiClient, entre outras.
* Investigação e mitigação de incidentes de segurança em endpoints corporativos.
* Detecção e Resposta a Ameaças:
* Implementação de estratégias de Threat Hunting e análise de comportamento de ameaças.
* Uso de ferramentas de SIEM/SOAR para correlacionar eventos e automatizar respostas a incidentes.
* Análise e criação de regras personalizadas para aumentar a eficácia das soluções de segurança.
* Gerenciamento de Vulnerabilidades e Correção:
* Aplicação de melhores práticas de hardening em sistemas operacionais Windows, Linux e macOS.
* Análise e priorização de vulnerabilidades detectadas em endpoints, alinhando-se a frameworks como MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Suporte na implementação de políticas de patch management e controle de versões de software.
* Controle de Acesso e Proteção de Identidades:
* Integração de soluções de segurança de endpoints com ferramentas de Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Aplicação de políticas de Zero Trust para minimizar riscos de credenciais comprometidas.
* Monitoramento de acessos suspeitos e prevenção de movimentações laterais dentro da rede.

**Principais Requisitos**

* Graduação completa na área de TI;
* Experiência na administração de soluções de Endpoint Security;
* Conhecimento em proteção contra ameaças avançadas e resposta a incidentes;
* Experiência com soluções de EPP, EDR e XDR;
* Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST e CIS Controls;
* Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes ferramentas de segurança de ponta.

**Jornada De Trabalho**

* Segunda a sexta-feira das 08h às 17h (com 1 hora de intervalo);
* Presencial nos 3 primeiros meses (a partir do 4º mês, híbrido).

**Benefícios**

* - Cartão flexível (uso livre): Alimentação: R$ 32,14/dia + Transporte: R$ 23,60/dia;
* - Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (Cobertura de 70% para o colaborador titular e 50% para o primeiro dependente);
* - Auxílio Internet;
* - Bonificação mensal (baseada no Plano de Conformidade Operacional);
* - Premiação trimestral (OKR);
* - Planejamento de capacitação e certificações;
* - Incentivo ao curso de inglês (50%);
* - Plano de Carreira.

Salário: a combinar

Contrato: CLT (Efetivo)

jobs.title: MDM Sales Manager – Tijuana (M/F)
jobs.summary: With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such...
jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business. Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the role will be responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast. This is a remote role based in Tijuana, Mexico.

The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and expanding an existing portfolio of strategic customer accounts. In addition to new busi-ness development, the role has a strong key account management dimension, ensuring long-term custom-er growth, satisfaction, and partnership. To successfully manage this portfolio, the Sales Manager fosters alignment and effective collaboration across the regional sales organization.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager works closely with cus-tomers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen strategic customer relationships, identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, and drive order intake and market expansion.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including Tijuana, Mexico, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast, as well as occasional travel to France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast.

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*

jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer, Client Platform - Application Stability and Performance
jobs.summary: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in! At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical...
jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems , running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

 About the role...

As an Android engineer on our Application Stability and Performance team you’ll own the stability and performance of the Duolingo Android Learning app for millions of learners.

This team builds the tooling other engineers depend on to keep the app performant like AI agent driven crash and memory analysis, coroutine system tracing, and Macrobenchmark suites that catch regressions before they ship. You'll also own the performance metrics that feed into our experiment analyses and help ensure hundreds of concurrent experiments surface any performance issues or regressions.

 🧠 You will...

- Lead architectural initiatives to fix the slowest parts of the app, from startup to critical learning flows

- Own and evolve our performance tooling with tracing, benchmarking, and automated regression detection

- Serve as a bridge between Client Platform and Product feature teams, helping them understand and act on the performance data we provide

- Foster a culture of engineering excellence around performance and mentor engineers of all experience levels

 ✅ You have...

- Worked on and shipped large scale Android applications

- Experience identifying the root cause and resolving ANRs, memory leaks, dropped frames, and complex crashes

- Strong Kotlin skills and deep familiarity with coroutines, Jetpack Compose, and modern architecture patterns

- Experience optimizing startup time, memory, and network usage for low-memory devices

- Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for tackling difficult challenges

 ⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

- Expertise in Android tracing tooling like the AndroidX Tracing Library and Perfetto

- Experience with crash observability tooling like Sentry and Android Vitals

 The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Salary Range:

 $182,800 - $247,300 USD

 Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here .

 Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here .

 Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com .

 Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.

jobs.description:
Overview

Job specifications are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed by employees. Specifications are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job.

SUMMARY:

The Senior Systems Administrator shall demonstrate experience in systems administration in the following operating systems: UNIX, Linux, or Windows. The specialized experience includes Linux system administration of Redhat and security setup and updates (IAVA's); UNIX system administration of Solaris, UNIX scripting, Thin Client, Sudo, IDM, NTFS, CIFS, DNS, RDP Client, and security setup and updates (IAVA's); Windows system administration of WSUS and third party solutions, GPOs Windows Server and Windows Workstations, Thin Clients (hardware/software), Networking and documentation creation/updates.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  Possess the ability to install, configure and maintain Operating Systems.

   Manage the installation and integration of systems fixes, updates and enhancements Conduct testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization and maintenance of hardware and software systems.

   Provide support including end user assistance.

   Perform functions such as manage accounts, network rights, access to systems and equipment; maintain systems configuration and backups.

   Create and maintain documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).

   Create, monitor and maintain backups/restoration of systems and files.

   Conduct research of new and upcoming technologies.

   Provide input for future systems and purchases.

   Demonstrate general knowledge of enterprise frameworks and methodologies.

   Possess the ability to communicate effectively both written and verbally.

   Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience:

Advanced PowerShell scripting for automation (compliance remediation, report extraction, deployment triggers). Experience with vulnerability management tools: Qualys, Tenable Nessus, or Rapid7 InsightVM. Knowledge of Windows OS lifecycle, patch Tuesday cycle, CBS, WUA, and WinSxS. Understanding of BitLocker, Windows Defender, and endpoint security baselines (CIS / STIG). Experience integrating patch workflows with ServiceNow ITSM and CMDB. Working knowledge of Azure AD, Entra ID, and Conditional Access policies. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex patch failures. Proactive mindset identifies process gaps and proposes improvements. Ability to manage concurrent workstreams under deadline pressure. jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the laptops and handsets every Anthropic employee works on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and every piece of configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the mobile side of the fleet is BYOD. This role exists to change that. You will design and implement a corporate-issued mobile device program (managed company phones and managed Apple accounts) in every region Anthropic operates in, and take it from early design to production.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what a corporate mobile program looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

### Responsibilities

- Design the corporate-issued mobile device program: device standards, what we issue to whom, and how the program grows from a first region to everywhere Anthropic operates
- Own the global logistics of issuing hardware: procurement partners, regional coverage, spares, and refresh cycles
- Bring mobile configuration into the team’s config-as-code pipeline so mobile policies are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
- Build zero-touch enrollment: Apple Business Manager and ADE with managed Apple accounts on iOS, the zero-touch equivalent on Android, so a new phone works the first time without hands-on setup
- Own policy, compliance, and device lifecycle for the corporate fleet, from issue to wipe
- Build telemetry on the corporate fleet: which devices are checking in, OS and patch state, drift between reported and actual state
- Own managed app distribution for mobile, from app approval through update rollout
- Partner with Corporate Security on device posture, device trust signals, and travel devices for international trips
- Decide how corporate-issued and BYOD coexist, and own that boundary as the program rolls out

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have owned a global or multi-region mobile device program end to end, with 8+ years managing corporate fleets at thousands-of-devices scale
- Go deep on iOS device management: enrollment flows, Apple Business Manager and ADE, APNs and certificate lifecycle, declarative device management
- Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
- Treat device configuration as code and have moved past clicking in consoles
- Have run the infrastructure under an MDM, not just administered a SaaS console: a self-hosted MDM server, AWS, Terraform, and configuration that ships as code
- Have built or launched a corporate device program, not just operated one, and can decide how it coexists with BYOD
- Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience
- View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
- Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

### Strong candidates may also

- Have managed ChromeOS devices alongside a mobile fleet
- Have run a device program across multiple regions and dealt with the logistics that come with it
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Bring proficiency in Swift for building device tooling
- Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

### Technical Skills

- Python and shell scripting
- iOS and Android platform internals (depth on iOS, working knowledge of Android)
- Modern MDM or UEM platforms (Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, or equivalent)
- Running the infrastructure under an MDM (self-hosted servers, AWS GCP, Terraform)
- Querying live device state at fleet scale
- Mobile device lifecycle automation (enrollment, policy, patching, app distribution)
- GitOps and CI for configuration management
- Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

         Strong GitHub/Git -based development experience.
         Fast learner and experience with IaC fundamentals and monitoring solution

jobs.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: California (USA), Texas (USA)

Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

We are searching for a Principal Fraud Strategist to own SoFi’s authentication and device trust discipline end to end. This is a sophisticated, platform-level role at the intersection of adversarial threat intelligence, device intelligence, and risk decisioning architecture. You will design the layered defense that protects every member session at SoFi: login, password reset, MFA, step-up, account recovery, and high-risk transaction moments across web and mobile. You will own device trust outright: identification, recognition, intelligence, entity resolution, and the signal development work that keeps SoFi ahead of ATO, scam, and perimeter attack patterns as they evolve. The role spans strategy, orchestration, and vendor stack design (Transmit Security Mosaic and beyond), and scales across Money, Invest, Crypto, Card, and Lending. You will work cross-functionally with EPD, IAM, Fraud Ops, InfoSec, Product, and Data Science, and influence vendor roadmaps where SoFi’s needs run ahead of what the market ships.

By joining SoFi, you'll become part of a forward-thinking company that is transforming financial services for the better. We offer the excitement of a rapidly growing startup with the stability of an industry leading leadership team.

What you’ll do:

The Principal Fraud Strategist, Authentication and Device Trust will help SoFi build and continuously evolve a layered authentication and device trust defense by:

Owning end-to-end strategy for authentication and device trust across web and mobile: signal architecture, decisioning topology, rule construction, threshold tuning, champion/challenger lifecycle, and rule-level loss and false-positive attribution.

Architecting the layered perimeter defense against ATO, scam interception (authorized push payment, remote access, impostor, investment, business email compromise), credential stuffing, MFA bombing, OTP interception, SIM swap, adversary-in-the-middle phishing, and emulator-driven bot traffic. Convert live campaign telemetry into policy changes at the speed of the attack.

Owning the device trust discipline: device identification, recognition, and intelligence across web and mobile; behavioral biometrics; network reputation; device-graph and entity resolution; emulator and VM detection; jailbreak and root signals; residential-proxy detection; and signal development for gaps the current vendor stack does not cover.

Orchestrating the vendor stack that underpins authentication and device trust (Transmit Security Mosaic and adjacent providers): capability assessment, integration design, data flow architecture, decision timing, and continuous performance tuning. Influence vendor roadmaps where SoFi has needs the market has not yet met.

Designing step-up authentication, account recovery, and high-risk transaction decisioning that synthesizes device, behavioral, network, and credential-risk signals into a single decision with explicit FPR budgets per surface. Keep controls invisible to legitimate members wherever possible.

Leading 3DS, CNP, and tokenization decisioning for card-not-present transactions, coordinating with issuer processing and network rules to optimize approval rate without ceding losses.

Partnering with InfoSec threat intelligence on credential-capture campaigns, phishing kits, SEO poisoning, and ATO-as-a-service marketplaces. Translate intelligence into rule changes inside the live policy stack and into new signal development priorities.

Setting the technical bar for how SoFi builds durable fraud defense. Mentor the broader fraud strategy organization on authentication, device intelligence, and adversarial reasoning.

What you’ll need:

BA/BS in Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related fields, or equivalent work experience, and 15+ years of work experience in Fraud Strategy, Authentication Risk, Device Intelligence, or Adversarial Security Engineering.

ATO and Scam Defense: Deep track record reducing account takeover and scam losses across banking, card, crypto, and P2P surfaces. Fluency across the full kill chain: credential exposure, login compromise, in-session manipulation (remote access, screen share, social engineering), and money movement out.

Perimeter Threat Fluency: Operational understanding of credential stuffing, MFA bombing, OTP interception, SIM swap, adversary-in-the-middle phishing, residential-proxy abuse, and emulator-driven automation. You have recognized campaigns in flight from telemetry and responded at the policy layer, more than once.

Device Intelligence and Forensics: Hands-on architectural experience with device identification, recognition, and intelligence platforms. Fluency in device fingerprinting, emulator and VM detection, jailbreak and root signals, behavioral biometrics, and entity-level device-graph analysis. Direct experience with Transmit Security Mosaic, Iovation, ThreatMetrix, BioCatch, or comparable platforms as a builder, not just a consumer.

Signal Development: Proven ability to identify signal gaps in production systems and develop new signals, either directly or in partnership with vendors, that close them. You do not wait for a vendor to invent the detection you need.

Risk Architecture and Vendor Orchestration: Track record designing holistic fraud systems across multiple vendors, data feeds, and decisioning layers, with clear ownership of decision timing, feedback loops, metrics, and incident response paths.

Authentication Stack Depth: Working knowledge of FIDO2/passkeys, OAuth/OIDC, 3DS protocol mechanics, tokenization, and the trade-offs between approval rate and chargeback exposure on CNP flows.

Balance Friction and Growth: Deep mastery of evaluating trade-offs between fraud mitigation and UX. Keeps controls invisible to legitimate members wherever possible and spends friction judiciously where it delivers the greatest incremental protection.

Architect Scalable Data Systems: Expert-level SQL/Python skills used to build automated, high-volume data architectures and statistical models that serve as the foundation for global risk detection.

Drive Strategic Influence: A proactive leader who uses cross-functional persuasion to align EPD, IAM, InfoSec, Fraud Ops, and vendor partners on strategy changes, and owns end-to-end execution in fluid environments.

Founders’ Mentality: You need to have a positive, proactive attitude, being able to identify problems, raise proposals, and be an advocate of your initiatives. Learn, iterate, and excel.

Compensation and Benefits

- Define device identity, posture, health, compliance, endpoint protection, and access signal requirements.

- Assess endpoint and device management technologies for interoperability and contribution to enterprise Zero Trust objectives.

- Support implementation planning, pilot execution, test cases, regression testing, and operational readiness.

- Coordinate device-related dependencies with identity, network, application, data, and automation teams.

- Document implementation results, exceptions, deviations, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Five or more years of endpoint security, device management, desktop engineering, or enterprise security engineering experience.

- Experience with endpoint protection, EDR, MDM/UEM, configuration management, and compliance assessment.

- Knowledge of device-centric Zero Trust and conditional access concepts.

- Strong troubleshooting and technical documentation skills.

- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, CrowdStrike, Tanium, or comparable enterprise endpoint platforms.

jobs.description:
About Snorkel

At Snorkel, we believe meaningful AI doesn’t start with the model, it starts with the data.

We’re on a mission to help enterprises transform expert knowledge into specialized AI at scale. The AI landscape has gone through incredible changes since 2015, when Snorkel started as a research project in the Stanford AI Lab, to the generative AI breakthroughs of today. But one thing has remained constant: the data you use to build AI is the key to achieving differentiation, high performance, and production-ready systems. We work with some of the world’s largest organizations to empower scientists, engineers, financial experts, product creators, journalists, and more to build custom AI with their data faster than ever before. Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

Job Description

We're seeking a Senior IT Platform & Automation Engineer who treats internal infrastructure like a product—not a firefighting exercise. This is not a traditional helpdesk or "break-fix" role. You'll be the architect behind our internal employee experience, acting as the connective tissue between our office network, collaboration services, security stack, and core business systems (People Tech, CRM, and Engineering tools).

If you prefer writing Python scripts over manually resetting passwords, and if you get excited about connecting Claude AI to Greenhouse via custom Slack workflows, we want to talk to you.

 This role is NOT:

- A traditional helpdesk position. You won't be resetting passwords or shipping laptops.

- A pure networking role. You'll touch networks, but automation is the priority.

- A machine learning engineer role. You'll experiment with AI, but you won't build vector databases or train models.

What You will Do

 Identity, Endpoint & Network (The Foundation)

- Identity & Access Management: Own our IdP (Okta/Auth0). Implement and automate SSO, MFA enforcement, and SCIM provisioning across all SaaS tools. Enforce zero-trust principles everywhere.

- Endpoint Lifecycle: Own the full hardware and MDM lifecycle. Automate device provisioning, configuration, and secure deployment using Jamf and Intune. Build zero-touch onboarding workflows. (Note: You will own the automation and security profiles; physical device shipping/fulfillment is handled by our IT Ops coordinators.)

- Network Engineering: Design, deploy, and maintain high-availability office networking (cloud-managed switching/routing, Wi-Fi) and secure remote access solutions (ZTNA/VPN) for a hybrid workforce. We prioritize automation-first engineers.

 Custom Integrations & Automation (The Builder Work)

- API Integrations: Architect and build custom integrations between our core SaaS stack—syncing data between Okta, Greenhouse, Notion, and our CRM to eliminate manual data entry.

- Workflow Orchestration: Own our internal automation layer. We currently use a mix of lightweight no-code tools (Zapier, App Script, AppSheet) and custom Python. We're actively phasing out low-code for mission-critical paths—you'll have permission to replace them with proper code. To be clear: this is a coding-heavy role. You'll spend the majority of your time writing code, not clicking in UIs. The no-code tools are placeholders—we expect you to replace or maintain them.

- Internal Tooling: Build and maintain internal dashboards and Slack apps that give employees self-service access to IT, HR, and facilities requests.

 AI & LLM Experimentation (The Innovation Work)

- AI Integrations: Review and assess connectors (MCP) if available. Otherwise, build lightweight API wrappers and prompt engineering pipelines to connect LLMs (Claude, OpenAI) to internal tools like Slack and Notion.

- R&D Time: Dedicated time each sprint to experiment with new AI models and identify productivity gains for the company.

 Security Automation & Compliance (The Glue)

- Security Scripting: Write robust scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell) to automate security monitoring, endpoint patch management, and compliance reporting.

- Alert Correlation: Architect centralized alerting pipelines by integrating EDR/SIEM webhooks into Slack via native integrations (CrowdStrike), filtering noise and surfacing only actionable security anomalies.

- Compliance Automation: Create automated audit trails, access reviews, and reporting to support SOC2 / ISO compliance efforts—no more manual spreadsheet work.

 Tech Stack Summary: Python, Okta/Azure AD, Jamf/Intune, Slack API, Greenhouse API, Notion API, Claude/OpenAI APIs, CrowdStrike, Meraki/cloud-networking, Google Workspace + GAM, Jira.

Who You Are

 Foundation (Must-Have Baseline)

- Experience: 4+ years in IT Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Platform roles with a heavy emphasis on automation and APIs.

- Coding Proficiency: Advanced Python or JavaScript/Node.js. You treat your scripts like software—git, CI/CD, testing, and documentation are non-negotiable. Our current automation stack is built on Python. Familiarity with either is sufficient—we don't expect you to know both.

- API Fluency: Proven experience building custom integrations using REST/GraphQL APIs. You know how to read documentation, handle OAuth2, and parse JSON in your sleep.

- IdP & MDM Experience: Hands-on experience with Okta or Azure AD (SCIM, Workflows, automation) AND at least one MDM solution (Jamf and Intune).

- Security-First Mindset: You understand least privilege, automated patching, and think about security in every integration you build.

 Primary Focus Areas (Where You'll Spend Most of Your Time)

- Core: Identity & Workflow Automation (Okta, SCIM, custom scripting)

- Core: Endpoint Management & security ops related (MDM, zero-touch deployment, patching)

- Secondary: Networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPN/ZTNA—enough to troubleshoot and configure, not necessarily design from scratch)

We prioritize automation-first engineers who can learn networking depth on the job. If you're a networking rockstar who's also strong on MDM and automation, even better.

 High-Value Differentiators (Stand Out From the Crowd)

- Direct experience with Okta, People Tech (Rippling and Greenhouse), Notion, or Slack APIs

- Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) for internal tools

- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

- Experience preparing IT systems for SOC2 or ISO 27001 audits

- Experience with Google Workspace administration and GAM

- Experience with zero-touch deployment workflows (Apple Business Manager, Windows Autopilot)

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Salary range(s) for this role

 $150,000 - $220,000 USD

 Be Your Best at Snorkel

Joining Snorkel AI means becoming part of a company that has market proven solutions, robust funding, and is scaling rapidly—offering a unique combination of stability and the excitement of high growth. As a member of our team, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to shape priorities and initiatives, influence key strategic decisions, and directly impact our ongoing success. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, explore leadership opportunities, or learn new skills across multiple functions, you’re fully supported in building your career in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.

 Snorkel AI is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Snorkel AI embraces diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Snorkel AI prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, performance, merit, and business need.

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Professional Services Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with clients to understand their unique technical requirements, diagnose issues, and provide effective solutions. Your ability to dive into log files, troubleshoot complex problems, and debug issues will be essential in delivering exceptional consulting services. By leveraging your technical expertise and industry knowledge, you will ensure successful implementation, configuration, and integration of our product, while providing training and support to enable clients to maximize the value of our solution.

### **What You'll Do**

- Take charge of the implementation and configuration process, ensuring the seamless integration and successful deployment of Cyberhaven’s solution within clients’ existing environments.

- Foster close collaboration with clients to gain a deep understanding of their technical requirements, diagnose issues, and create customized dataset and policy solutions.

- Utilize log file analysis, debugging techniques, and advanced troubleshooting to identify underlying causes of complex technical problems and coordinate effective resolutions with our Support, Engineering, and Operations teams.

- Work in close partnership with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, and support staff, to deliver high-quality solutions that adhere to timelines.

- Deliver technical training to end users, empowering them with the necessary knowledge and skills to maximize the utilization of Cyberhaven to optimize their workflows and expedite ROI.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, offering strategic guidance, best practices, and insights to help them derive the maximum value from our product.

- Conduct regular progress updates, status meetings, and post-implementation reviews with clients to ensure their satisfaction or identify areas for improvement, serving as the internal and external point of contact for client escalations.

- Collaborate with the development and support teams, promptly escalating and resolving technical issues or system discrepancies to maintain smooth operations for clients.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in our product offerings, continuously enhancing your technical expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to clients.

### **Who You Are**

- 3+ years of Solutions Engineer, Delivery Manager, or Professional Services with Endpoint Security experience required in the Cybersecurity and DLP Space:

  - Proven track record of delivering complex technical solutions, preferably in a Professional Services or Consulting role, specifically with endpoint security products.

  - Previous experience with other DLP solutions such as Forcepoint, Symantec, McAfee DLP, Fortra (Digital Guardian), Trend Micro, Check Point, Next DLP, or Proofpoint.

  - Understanding of data classification methodologies and techniques to effectively identify sensitive data types and define appropriate DLP policies.
- Project Management: Ability to manage and deliver against strict timelines, requiring constant prioritization and mitigation strategy-building.

- Deep technical background, with hands-on experience in supporting and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.

  - Software debugging skills

  - Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, and data integration techniques.

  - Solid understanding of system architecture, network protocols, and Google Cloud Platform.

  - Practical knowledge of the MacOS (e.g., MDM, app management, basic terminal skills) and Windows (SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, understanding PowerShell scripts, etc.) ecosystems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, allowing one to easily convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders and build relationships cross-functionally.

- Knowledge of system software design (services, drivers, agents).

- Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent advanced industry certifications, or 3+ years of experience in a similar role.

- Candidate location preference: must be based in greater Mexico City area

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

  SR. BAW DEVICE ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

 Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.

 XBAW technology utilizes MEMS-based thin film transfer process, enabling a broad range of piezoelectric material synthesis and compositions tailored for specific application needs with enhanced material properties and an optimized resonator performance including superior figure of merit from coupling and Q factor. Our Device Engineers plays a critical role in developing and improving XBAW resonators and supporting filter designs. This person will perform FEM simulations and experimental DOE to improve the figure of merit of BAW resonators, with an emphasis on developing efficient process integration and reduced cycle time for lean filter development.

  RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Develop and improve FEA setups (COMSOL, HFSS) for BAW resonator simulations and optimization

- Improve the performance of bulk acoustic wave resonators for RF filter applications

- Develop and improve thin film bulk acoustic wave resonator process for better performance, accuracy, high yield as well as short cycle time

- Support BAW filter design with dimensions and process integration

- Define and generate resonator equivalent circuit models to be used in filter design

- Plan experimental setups with multiple parameters

 BAW DEVICE ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations.
